reviews.author: JaredHylton
reviews.title: Operating Standards (especially for foreigners) dropping significantly
reviews.content: Operating standards for non-Chinese citizens, has basically made AliPay unusable unless you’re a person living full-time with a Resident Card on the Chinese Mainland, or are a Chinese, HK, or Macau citizen. Taiwan… is even iffy. Weixin Pei is integrated into WeChat, and I see most people using that these days due to coupons and discounts that AliPay just doesn’t have enough of. They need to do some massive changing for tourists coming to China, or expand the network GLOBALLY and handle payment processing… but essentially, if not in China… then you’re gonna have some kind of weird errors, trouble paying, errors with authentication due to the The Great Firewall, and much more. It’s not… as user-friendly in my experience as setting up and using Weixin Pei. AliGroup, you need to get some rest and wake up with some new ideas.

reviews.content: Unfortunately, over 98% of the places don't accept credit card and Alipay or WeChat pay is the only option (visited May 2024). Worked less than 50%. I tried changing the payment passcode and they asked for ID and did not accept my passport as a valid ID. Usually, it's larger or chain stores that scanned me...other smaller vendors usually only have a QR code up for you to scan. When I had to scan others, it was 0% success because it required the payment passcode and as mentioned above, they never let me set one and did not accept my passport as a valid ID to change it. Alipay has other options such as calling taxis, paying for public transit, etc but unfortunately, none of them worked. My Alipay was also a lot slower than the Chinese version one. It would be hold on payment processing for awhile but it would work. I would consider myself a pretty tech savvy person, and I found this app impossible to use. Additionally, you would have to click the translate button because sometimes the page doesn't translate (for those whose mandarin isn't as smooth).

reviews.author: Towermagi
reviews.title: Scammy company
reviews.content: This whole system/company feels like a SCAM for anyone NOT a citizen or permanent resident of Mainland China. They offer travelers a Travel Pass for people who are visiting China but then after depositing money into Travel Pass they lock your account and claim they need to verify your identity and can only do so with a Mainland China bank card. Well, guess what? You can’t get a Mainland Chinese bank card without being a citizen or permanent resident. So much for Travel Pass working for travelers who aren’t either. Customer service is an absolute joke. I have tried the US support number (it’s always voicemail, I left several A MONTH ago, not holding my breath on a response), the Chinese support number is “no longer in service”, I have sent several emails and I have even tried Facebook. I have never encountered a company of this supposed size that is so unprofessional bordering on fraudulent. In fact this whole system appears to be one giant scam because they claim Travel Pass is for foreigners to China but then require citizen status (only after they have taken your money). Here is what happened to me: They let me register for the app with my US debit card. Everything went through perfectly fine, the app even said I can use my US debit card to verify my identity. I then put 500RMB into my Travel Pass account. Then the next day, when I tried to launch the app, they claimed they needed to reverify my identity. I put in my US debit card again and got the message that they cannot accept that card as verification. So my card was good enough to let me register and then deduct money from, but once they’ve taken the money, my card is no longer good for verification? Sounds like a SCAM to me. Check Facebook, I’m not the only one that fell for this scam, there are a ton of people on there with their money taken and then unable to reverify. I will be filing a complaint for this company with the Apple app store because they should not be allowed to be on here.

extra.evidence_quote: they lock your account and claim they need to verify your identity

version_plan.rationale: High-impact: Many international users cannot register, verify, or use the app due to SMS, card linking, and identity verification failures. These issues block core functionality and drive negative reviews. Feasibility: Requires backend and localization improvements, but can be prioritized with dedicated teams.

High-impact: Users frequently complain about bloat, ads, and performance issues, which degrade the core payment experience. Feasibility: UI/UX changes and performance optimizations can be done incrementally.
High-impact: Poor localization and untranslated Chinese text hinder international users. Feasibility: Translation and localization improvements are relatively straightforward.

High-impact: Account suspensions, privacy concerns, and distrust are serious issues that affect user retention and brand reputation. Feasibility: Requires policy and security reviews, but can be addressed with clearer communication and improved processes.
Medium-impact: Interface complexity and missing dark mode are common complaints. Feasibility: UI redesign and dark mode implementation are feasible with design resources.
Medium-impact: Payment failures and feature instability directly affect core functionality. Feasibility: Requires backend fixes and testing.
Medium-impact: Poor customer support exacerbates user frustration. Feasibility: Improving support channels and response times is feasible.
Medium-impact: Excessive ads and promotional pop-ups annoy users. Feasibility: Ad frequency and placement can be adjusted.
Medium-impact: Users want a more streamlined payment-focused app. Feasibility: Can be addressed by making non-core features optional or hidden.
Low-impact: Some users face crashes or missing features on specific devices. Feasibility: Requires testing and bug fixes for various devices.
Low-impact: Positive feedback indicates areas to maintain and build upon. Feasibility: Continue to support and enhance these aspects.
Low-impact: These findings have lower confidence or affect fewer users. Feasibility: Address as resources allow.

prd.analysis_goal: Improve the app based on user feedback

requirements.title: Implement alternative verification methods for international users
requirements.description: Provide alternative verification methods (e.g., email verification, phone call verification, or manual review) for users who cannot receive SMS verification codes, especially international users. This will reduce registration and login barriers.
acceptance_criteria: When SMS verification fails, the app offers at least one alternative verification method (e.g., email or call) within the same screen.
The alternative verification method successfully completes registration or login for at least 90% of test users who cannot receive SMS.
The app displays a clear error message and guidance when SMS fails, directing users to alternative options.

requirements.title: Improve credit card linking and transaction reliability for international users
requirements.description: Enhance the credit card linking and transaction process to support international cards and reduce failures. This includes better error messages, support for more card types, and fallback options.
acceptance_criteria: The app supports at least 95% of major international credit card brands (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, etc.) for linking and transactions.
When a card linking fails, the app provides a specific error message indicating the reason (e.g., card not supported, address mismatch) and suggests next steps.
The transaction success rate for international users increases by at least 20% after the update.

requirements.title: Streamline identity verification process
requirements.description: Simplify the identity verification process to reduce failures and frustration. This includes improving passport chip scanning, allowing manual entry fallback, reducing repeated uploads, and providing clearer instructions and error recovery.
acceptance_criteria: The passport chip scanning failure rate is reduced by at least 50% through improved scanning algorithm and user guidance.
Users can manually enter passport details as a fallback when chip scanning fails, without needing to upload multiple times.
The app does not show 'server busy' errors during verification; if a temporary error occurs, it automatically retries and informs the user.
The verification process can be completed within 5 minutes for 90% of users under normal conditions.

requirements.title: Reduce excessive personal information requests for foreign users
requirements.description: Review and minimize the personal information requested during verification for foreign users, ensuring only necessary data is collected. Provide clear explanations for why each piece of information is required.
acceptance_criteria: The number of required personal information fields for foreign users is reduced by at least 30% compared to the current version.
Each required field is accompanied by a tooltip or explanation of why it is needed.
Users can complete verification without providing optional information, and the app clearly marks which fields are optional.

requirements.title: Provide clear communication and support for verification issues
requirements.description: Enhance in-app messaging and support to help users understand verification requirements and resolve issues. This includes proactive notifications, a help center with troubleshooting guides, and a direct support channel.
acceptance_criteria: The app includes a help center article specifically addressing common verification issues for international users, accessible from the verification screen.
When a verification attempt fails, the app displays a clear, actionable error message with a link to the relevant help article.
Users can contact support directly from the verification screen, and the average response time is under 24 hours.

requirements.title: Simplify identity verification for foreign users
requirements.description: Redesign the identity verification flow to reduce complexity and failure rates for international users, including clearer instructions, support for foreign documents, and better error messages.
acceptance_criteria: The verification flow includes a step-by-step guide with visual examples for each document type.
Foreign users can upload passports or other international ID documents without errors.
Error messages during verification are specific and suggest corrective actions.
The verification success rate for foreign users increases by at least 20% within 3 months of release.

requirements.title: Support international payment methods
requirements.description: Expand payment options to include international credit/debit cards and alternative payment methods (e.g., PayPal) for users outside mainland China.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add and use international Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards.
Alternative payment methods like PayPal are available in the payment settings.
Payment failures due to card type are reduced by 50% for international users.
The payment flow clearly indicates which payment methods are supported in the user's region.

requirements.title: Provide multilingual support
requirements.description: Add support for multiple languages (e.g., English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese) for the app interface and key user flows, including onboarding, verification, and payment.
acceptance_criteria: The app interface is fully translated into at least 5 major languages.
Users can select their preferred language in settings, and the selection persists across sessions.
All onboarding, verification, and payment screens display correctly in the selected language without truncation or layout issues.
The language selection is automatically detected based on device locale, with manual override option.

requirements.title: Improve account setup and authentication for foreign users
requirements.description: Enhance the account setup and authentication process to be more intuitive for international users, including support for international phone numbers and email verification.
acceptance_criteria: Users can register with international phone numbers (including country codes) without errors.
Email verification links are sent and work correctly for all email providers.
The authentication flow provides clear instructions and error messages in the user's selected language.
The account setup completion rate for foreign users increases by at least 15% within 3 months.

requirements.title: Add region-specific feature availability messaging
requirements.description: Clearly communicate which features are available or restricted based on the user's region, and provide guidance on workarounds or alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: When a feature is unavailable in the user's region, a clear message explains the limitation and suggests alternatives.
The app displays region-specific information on the app store listing and in-app help center.
Users can access a help article that explains regional restrictions and workarounds.
The number of negative reviews mentioning 'not available outside China' decreases by 30% within 3 months.

requirements.title: Improve registration and verification error handling
requirements.description: Implement robust error handling for registration and verification processes to prevent blocking errors like 'too many attempts' and failed authentication. Provide clear, actionable error messages and allow users to retry after a reasonable cooldown period.
acceptance_criteria: When a user encounters a 'too many attempts' error, the app displays a clear message with the cooldown duration and a countdown timer.
The app allows users to retry verification after the cooldown period without requiring a full restart of the registration process.
All error messages during registration and verification are localized and provide specific guidance on how to resolve the issue.
The app logs verification failures with error codes and timestamps for debugging and monitoring.

requirements.title: Fix Tour Card and Tour Pass functionality
requirements.description: Resolve the issues preventing the Tour Card and Tour Pass features from working correctly, ensuring users can activate and use these features as intended.
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully activate a Tour Card or Tour Pass without encountering errors.
The Tour Card and Tour Pass features are fully functional, allowing users to access the intended services.
Any error messages related to Tour Card or Tour Pass are clear and provide steps to resolve the issue.
The app includes automated tests to verify the Tour Card and Tour Pass flows work across different user scenarios.

requirements.title: Enhance phone number verification process
requirements.description: Improve the phone number verification flow to handle format errors and system busy messages gracefully, allowing users to complete verification without being blocked.
acceptance_criteria: The app validates phone numbers in real-time and provides immediate feedback on format errors before submission.
When the system is busy, the app shows a friendly message and automatically retries the verification request after a short delay.
Users can resend the verification code after a specified interval, with a countdown timer displayed.
The phone number verification process completes successfully for valid numbers without blocking the user.

requirements.title: Simplify real-name verification for international users
requirements.description: Streamline the real-name verification process to reduce failures for users with valid documents or bank cards, especially for international users.
acceptance_criteria: The real-name verification process accepts a wider range of document types and formats.
Users receive clear instructions on what documents are accepted and how to submit them correctly.
The app provides a fallback option for manual review when automated verification fails.
The verification success rate for international users increases by at least 20% after the update.

requirements.title: Support international identity verification
requirements.description: Implement alternative identity verification methods for international users, such as passport or international ID, and remove the requirement for a Chinese ID or bank card during onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: International users can complete identity verification using a passport or international ID without a Chinese ID or bank card.
The onboarding flow detects the user's region and presents appropriate verification options.
Verification success rate for international users increases by at least 20% within one month of release.

requirements.title: Prevent account freezes after deposit
requirements.description: Implement a pre-deposit verification check and clear communication about verification requirements to prevent accounts from being frozen after depositing money, especially for non-residents.
acceptance_criteria: Users are prompted to complete verification before making a deposit if their account is not fully verified.
The app displays a clear warning about potential account freezes if verification is incomplete.
No new reports of accounts being frozen immediately after deposit for non-residents within two months of release.

requirements.title: Simplify account verification process
requirements.description: Streamline the account verification process by reducing required documents, providing clearer instructions, and offering real-time support to minimize user frustration and account lockouts.
acceptance_criteria: The verification form requires no more than three steps and provides inline help for each field.
Users can reach a support agent via chat or email within 24 hours if verification fails.
The number of support tickets related to verification issues decreases by 30% within three months of release.

requirements.title: Provide clear error messages for verification failures
requirements.description: Enhance error messages during verification to explain the specific reason for failure and suggest actionable steps, reducing user confusion and lockouts.
acceptance_criteria: Each verification failure displays a specific error code and a plain-language explanation.
The error message includes a link to a help article or support contact.
Users can retry verification without restarting the entire process after fixing the issue.

requirements.title: Support international credit/debit card linking
requirements.description: Enable users outside China to link their foreign credit or debit cards to the app, ensuring full functionality for international users.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add a foreign credit or debit card from at least 10 major international banks or card networks.
The card linking process accepts non-Chinese billing addresses and phone numbers.
A clear error message is shown if a card is not supported, with instructions for alternative payment methods.

requirements.title: Support international bank account linking
requirements.description: Allow international users to link their foreign bank accounts for direct payments and transfers, expanding app usability beyond China.
acceptance_criteria: Users can link a bank account from at least 5 major international banks or via a supported payment network (e.g., SWIFT, SEPA).
The bank account linking flow supports international routing numbers and IBANs.
Users receive confirmation of successful bank account linking within 2 business days.

requirements.title: Provide clear guidance for international users
requirements.description: Add in-app guidance and support documentation to help international users understand how to link cards or bank accounts, and what to do if they encounter issues.
acceptance_criteria: A help center article explains supported international payment methods and step-by-step linking instructions.
When a user attempts to link an unsupported card or bank, a tooltip or modal directs them to the help center.
The guidance is available in English and at least 3 other major languages.

requirements.title: Remove or hide non-core features (AI, video, ads) from the main user flow
requirements.description: Users complain that the app is bloated with unwanted features such as AI, video, and ads, which detract from its core payment functionality. To address this, we will declutter the main user interface by removing or hiding these non-core features, making the core payment functionality more prominent and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: The main screen of the app displays only core payment features (e.g., send money, request money, transaction history) without any AI, video, or ad content.
Non-core features are either removed entirely or moved to a secondary menu that requires at least two taps to access.
No ads or promotional pop-ups appear during the primary payment flow (from opening the app to completing a transaction).

requirements.title: Implement an ad-free experience for core payment transactions
requirements.description: Users are frustrated by excessive ads, promotional pop-ups, and intrusive content that degrade the app experience. To improve user satisfaction, we will ensure that the core payment transaction flow is completely free of ads and promotional interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: No ads or promotional pop-ups are displayed during the payment flow (from initiating a payment to receiving confirmation).
Users can complete a payment without encountering any ad content.
If ads are shown elsewhere in the app, they do not appear on the payment confirmation screen.

requirements.title: Optimize app performance to reduce lag and overheating
requirements.description: Users perceive the app as bloated with unnecessary features, causing lag, overheating, and poor performance. We will optimize the app's performance by reducing resource consumption, improving startup time, and ensuring smooth interactions.
acceptance_criteria: App startup time is reduced by at least 30% compared to the previous version.
The app does not cause noticeable overheating on standard devices during normal usage (e.g., 10 minutes of continuous use).
Scrolling and navigation within the app are smooth with no visible lag (frame rate above 30 fps).

requirements.title: Provide a user setting to control non-core features and ads
requirements.description: To give users more control over their experience, we will add a settings option that allows users to hide or disable non-core features (AI, video, ads) and reduce the amount of promotional content they see.
acceptance_criteria: A new 'Content Preferences' section is available in the app settings.
Users can toggle off AI features, video content, and ads from the settings.
When a user disables ads, no ads are shown anywhere in the app for that user.

requirements.title: Optimize app size and storage usage
requirements.description: Reduce the app's storage footprint by optimizing assets, removing unused code, and implementing on-demand resource loading to address user complaints about excessive storage usage and bloat.
acceptance_criteria: App size is reduced by at least 20% compared to the previous version.
Storage usage after typical usage is reduced by at least 30%.
No regression in app functionality or performance.

requirements.title: Improve app performance and responsiveness
requirements.description: Enhance app performance by optimizing code, reducing lag, and fixing crashes to address user reports of slowness and performance issues.
acceptance_criteria: App launch time is reduced by at least 15%.
No crashes reported in the top 100 user flows during beta testing.
User-perceived lag is reduced, as measured by a 20% improvement in app responsiveness metrics.

requirements.title: Remove intrusive ads

acceptance_criteria: Ads are no longer displayed during critical user flows (e.g., payment, login).

requirements.title: Streamline interface to focus on core payment features
requirements.description: Simplify the user interface by removing non-financial features and decluttering the interface to emphasize the app's core payment purpose.
acceptance_criteria: The main screen displays only payment-related actions and information.

requirements.title: Fix device compatibility issues
