Support for at least 95% of active device models.

requirements.title: Reduce cache size and add missing widgets
requirements.description: Optimize cache management to reduce cache size and add missing widgets to improve usability, as reported by users.
acceptance_criteria: Cache size is reduced by at least 25% after typical usage.
Widgets requested by users are added and functional.
Users can easily clear cache from settings.

requirements.title: Optimize app performance to reduce overheating
requirements.description: Investigate and fix causes of device overheating during heavy usage, particularly when using stock viewing features or on newer iPhone models. Implement performance optimizations to reduce CPU and GPU load.
acceptance_criteria: App does not cause device temperature to exceed 40°C during 30 minutes of continuous stock viewing on iPhone 14 Pro Max.
CPU usage during stock viewing is reduced by at least 20% compared to previous version.
No user reports of overheating in beta testing with a sample of 100 users.

requirements.title: Fix performance issues with verification codes and system busy errors
requirements.description: Address slow verification code delivery and system busy errors that disrupt user experience. Improve backend response times and error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Verification code is delivered within 5 seconds in 95% of test cases.
System busy error rate is reduced to less than 1% of all requests.
No user reports of system busy errors in beta testing with a sample of 100 users.

requirements.title: Reduce app size and improve loading speed
requirements.description: Optimize app resources and code to reduce the app's storage footprint and improve launch and navigation speed.
acceptance_criteria: App size is reduced by at least 15% compared to previous version.
App launch time is reduced by at least 20% on a mid-range device (e.g., iPhone 11).
App navigation between main screens is smooth with no visible lag in 95% of test cases.

requirements.title: Fix display bugs on Apple Watch and other devices
requirements.description: Resolve display issues reported on Apple Watch and other devices, ensuring proper rendering of UI elements.
acceptance_criteria: All UI elements render correctly on Apple Watch Series 6 and later in test cases.
No display glitches reported in beta testing on a sample of 50 Apple Watch users.
App passes UI consistency tests on iPhone SE, iPhone 11, and iPhone 14 Pro Max.

requirements.title: Improve overall app stability and reduce crashes
requirements.description: Identify and fix common crash causes to improve app stability and reduce crash rate.
acceptance_criteria: Crash rate is reduced to less than 0.5% of sessions in beta testing.
No crashes occur during 30 minutes of continuous usage in test scenarios.
All reported crash scenarios from user reviews are resolved and verified in regression tests.

requirements.title: Simplify feature set to reduce bloat
requirements.description: Audit existing features and remove or hide non-essential features that contribute to perceived bloat, focusing on core functionality to improve simplicity and performance.
acceptance_criteria: A list of non-essential features is identified and either removed or hidden behind an 'Advanced' toggle.
The app's main screen shows only core features, with no more than 5 primary actions.
User feedback indicates a reduction in complaints about bloat in subsequent reviews.

requirements.title: Optimize app performance to reduce lag and crashes
requirements.description: Improve app stability and responsiveness by addressing performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and background processes that cause lag, crashes, and restarts.
acceptance_criteria: App launch time is reduced by at least 30% compared to the previous version.
No crashes or background restarts are reported in internal testing over a 7-day period.
App responsiveness (e.g., scrolling, navigation) shows no visible lag on mid-range devices.

requirements.title: Reduce battery consumption from background activity
requirements.description: Minimize background activity and optimize resource usage to reduce battery drain, ensuring the app does not consume excessive power when in the background.
acceptance_criteria: Background activity is limited to essential tasks (e.g., push notifications) and does not run continuously.
Battery usage in background mode is reduced by at least 20% as measured by system profiler.
No user complaints about battery drain in the next release cycle.

requirements.title: Reduce app storage footprint
requirements.description: Optimize the app to reduce excessive storage consumption by implementing data caching limits, clearing temporary files, and compressing assets.
acceptance_criteria: App storage usage decreases by at least 20% after update compared to previous version.
No temporary files remain after app exit.
Assets are compressed without visible quality loss.

requirements.title: Remove unnecessary features and modules
requirements.description: Identify and remove or hide features that are rarely used or considered bloat, streamlining the app to improve speed and reduce clutter.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 features identified as low-usage are removed or hidden behind an 'Advanced' menu.
App launch time improves by at least 15% on average.
User interface remains intuitive with no more than 5 main navigation items.

requirements.title: Fix crashes and improve stability
requirements.description: Address reported crashes, slow processing, and device issues such as overheating and battery drain by optimizing code, fixing memory leaks, and improving resource management.
acceptance_criteria: Crash rate reduces by at least 50% compared to previous version.
App does not cause device overheating during normal use.
Battery drain during app usage is reduced by at least 20%.

requirements.title: Optimize mobile data usage
requirements.description: Reduce excessive mobile data consumption by implementing data compression, lazy loading, and caching strategies for network requests.
acceptance_criteria: Data usage per session decreases by at least 30% on average.
Images and videos load with reduced data without significant quality loss.
Users can enable a 'Low Data Mode' in settings.

requirements.title: Reduce app size and improve load time
requirements.description: Optimize the app to reduce its overall size and improve initial load time, addressing user complaints about the app being too large and slow. This includes compressing assets, removing unused code, and implementing lazy loading for non-critical features.
acceptance_criteria: The app's download size is reduced by at least 20% compared to the previous version.
The app's cold start time is reduced by at least 30% on a reference device.
The app's storage footprint after installation is reduced by at least 15%.

requirements.title: Optimize storage usage
requirements.description: Implement mechanisms to reduce the app's storage consumption over time, such as clearing cached data, compressing local databases, and providing users with a storage management option.
acceptance_criteria: The app's storage usage after 30 days of typical use is reduced by at least 20% compared to the previous version.
A 'Manage Storage' option is available in the app settings, allowing users to clear cache and temporary files.
The app automatically clears non-essential cached data when storage usage exceeds a predefined threshold.

requirements.title: Improve perceived performance during use
requirements.description: Enhance the app's responsiveness during common user interactions, such as navigation and content loading, to reduce perceived lag and improve overall user experience.
acceptance_criteria: The time to navigate between main screens is reduced by at least 25% on a reference device.
The app's UI remains responsive (no jank) during scrolling and animations, with a frame rate of at least 55 fps on a reference device.
The app's memory usage during typical usage is reduced by at least 15% compared to the previous version.

requirements.title: Enhance English localization across all app screens
requirements.description: Ensure all user-facing text, including menus, buttons, and notifications, is fully translated into English and other major languages, with proper grammar and context.
acceptance_criteria: All static UI strings are translated into English and at least 5 major languages (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean).
No untranslated Chinese text appears in any screen when the device language is set to English.
Translation accuracy is verified by native speakers for key flows (onboarding, settings, payment).

requirements.title: Fix in-app translation reliability and quality
requirements.description: Improve the in-app translation feature to provide accurate and consistent translations, especially for foreign users in China, and ensure translations do not fail randomly.
acceptance_criteria: In-app translation requests succeed 99% of the time under normal network conditions.
Translated text is contextually accurate for common phrases and does not contain obvious errors.
Users can manually switch to original text if translation is unsatisfactory.

requirements.title: Prevent language switching to Chinese during transactions
requirements.description: Ensure that the app does not automatically switch to Chinese during payment or transaction flows for non-Chinese users, and that the language remains consistent with the user's selected preference.
acceptance_criteria: When a user's device language is set to English, all transaction screens (payment, confirmation, receipt) display in English.
No language switch occurs during any step of the transaction flow.
A language preference setting is available and respected across all sessions.

requirements.title: Improve interface design for various screen sizes and languages
requirements.description: Adapt the interface to properly fit different screen sizes and ensure that text in English and other languages does not get cut off or overlap, providing a consistent user experience.
acceptance_criteria: UI elements are responsive and display correctly on common screen sizes (e.g., iPhone SE, iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPad).
Text in English and other languages is fully visible without truncation or overlap on all supported devices.
Layout adjustments are made to accommodate longer text strings in localized languages.

requirements.title: Localize all UI text to English
requirements.description: Replace all untranslated Chinese text in the app UI with English translations to ensure usability for international users.
acceptance_criteria: No Chinese characters appear in any UI screens when the device language is set to English.
All text strings are externalized to localization files.
A localization review is completed for all user-facing screens.

requirements.title: Simplify complex UI elements
requirements.description: Redesign complex UI elements that are difficult to understand, making the interface more intuitive for international users.
acceptance_criteria: User testing shows a reduction in task completion time for core features.
UI elements are consistent with platform design guidelines.
No user feedback mentions confusion about the interface after the update.

requirements.title: Ensure all features are usable in the US
requirements.description: Audit and fix features that are not functional or relevant in the US market, ensuring full usability for US users.
acceptance_criteria: All features are accessible and functional in the US region.
Any region-specific features are either adapted or clearly hidden for US users.
QA testing confirms no broken flows in the US locale.

requirements.title: Provide clear account suspension and resolution process
requirements.description: When an account is suspended, frozen, or restricted, the user should see a clear explanation of the reason and the steps to resolve it, including a direct link to customer support.
acceptance_criteria: When an account is suspended, the user sees a screen with the reason for suspension and a 'Contact Support' button.
The support contact method is reachable within two taps from the suspension notification.
The user can submit an appeal or request for review directly from the suspension screen.
The suspension screen includes an estimated resolution time or next steps.

requirements.title: Enhance transparency in data collection and verification
requirements.description: Provide users with clear, concise information about what personal data is collected, why it is needed, and how it is used, especially during verification processes. Also, ensure that verification steps are minimally invasive and clearly explained.
acceptance_criteria: The app displays a privacy policy link on the sign-up and verification screens.
During verification, each requested data point is accompanied by a brief explanation of why it is required.
Users can access a 'Data Usage' section in settings that lists all collected data types and their purposes.
The verification process does not request unnecessary permissions or data beyond what is essential for account security.

requirements.title: Implement proactive security notifications and user education
requirements.description: Send users proactive notifications about account security events (e.g., login from new device, password change) and provide in-app educational content about common scams and how to protect their account.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive a push notification when a new device logs into their account.
The notification includes a link to review recent account activity.
The app has a 'Security Tips' section accessible from the settings menu.
The security tips section includes at least three articles about common scams and account protection.

requirements.title: Provide clear and accessible customer support for account issues
requirements.description: Ensure that users can easily reach customer support for account-related issues, with multiple contact options and clear response time expectations.
acceptance_criteria: The app provides at least two support contact methods (e.g., email, in-app chat) for account issues.
The support section displays expected response times (e.g., 'We typically respond within 24 hours').
Users can access support from the account suspension screen and the settings menu.
Support requests include a reference number for tracking.

requirements.title: Provide transparent data usage policy
requirements.description: Add a clear, easily accessible privacy policy within the app that explains what personal data is collected, why it is collected, how it is used, and with whom it is shared. Ensure the policy is available in multiple languages, including English and Chinese, and is presented in a user-friendly format before any data collection occurs.
acceptance_criteria: The privacy policy is accessible from the app's main settings menu within two taps.
The policy clearly lists all data types collected, purposes, and third-party sharing partners.
The policy is available in at least English and Simplified Chinese, with a language selector.
Users must acknowledge the policy before any personal data is collected, with a confirmation dialog.

requirements.title: Implement explicit consent for sensitive data
requirements.description: Before collecting sensitive personal information such as passport details, face scans, or bank account information, present a dedicated consent screen that explains the specific purpose, data retention period, and user rights. Require explicit user action (e.g., checkbox or button) to proceed, and provide an option to decline without losing core app functionality.
acceptance_criteria: A consent screen appears before any sensitive data entry, explaining purpose and retention.
Users can decline consent and still use non-sensitive features of the app.
Consent choices are recorded and can be reviewed or revoked by the user in settings.
The consent screen includes a link to the full privacy policy.

requirements.title: Add in-app security and trust center
requirements.description: Create a dedicated 'Security & Trust' section within the app that addresses common user concerns about data security. Include information about encryption methods, data storage locations, compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR, PIPL), and steps the app takes to protect user data. Also provide a channel for users to report security concerns or request data deletion.
acceptance_criteria: The Security & Trust section is accessible from the main menu and contains at least five FAQ items addressing common privacy concerns.
The section includes a 'Contact Security Team' button that opens a support form or email.
The section provides a 'Request Data Deletion' option that initiates a verified process.
All content in the section is localized in English and Chinese.

requirements.title: Clarify data handling for foreign users
requirements.description: Provide specific information for non-Chinese users about why certain personal data (e.g., passport, bank account) is required, how it is protected, and any legal obligations. This can be in the form of a localized FAQ or a dedicated section within the privacy policy. Ensure the language is clear and addresses common concerns raised by foreign users.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated FAQ section for foreign users is available in English and Chinese.
The FAQ explains the legal basis for collecting sensitive data and how it is used.
The FAQ includes contact information for privacy inquiries.
The FAQ is linked from the consent screen and the Security & Trust section.

requirements.title: Enhance account security features
requirements.description: Implement additional security measures to protect user accounts, such as two-factor authentication (2FA), session management, and alerts for suspicious activity. This addresses user concerns about account suspension and potential misuse of data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can enable two-factor authentication via SMS or authenticator app in settings.
Users can view and manage active sessions, with the ability to revoke any session.
Users receive an email or push notification when a new device logs in.
Account suspension notifications include a clear reason and an appeal process.

requirements.title: Implement transparent account verification process
requirements.description: Provide clear and accessible account verification steps, including alternative verification methods for users without Chinese bank accounts, to reduce account lockouts and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view a detailed explanation of verification requirements before starting the process.
At least one alternative verification method (e.g., passport, ID card) is offered for users without Chinese bank accounts.
The verification process can be completed within 5 minutes on average.

requirements.title: Enhance privacy policy transparency
requirements.description: Update the privacy policy to clearly state what data is collected, how it is used, and whether it is shared with third parties, with easy-to-understand language and prominent access.
acceptance_criteria: The privacy policy is accessible within two taps from the main settings menu.
The policy includes a summary section in plain language explaining data collection and sharing.
Users can opt out of non-essential data sharing with third parties.

requirements.title: Add in-app privacy and security education
requirements.description: Provide users with clear information about app permissions and data usage, including why certain permissions are requested and how to manage them, to address privacy concerns.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Privacy & Security' section is available in the app settings with explanations for each permission.
Users can see a list of permissions the app has requested and the purpose for each.
The app provides a tutorial or tooltip when requesting sensitive permissions (e.g., camera, contacts).

requirements.title: Implement proactive account security alerts
requirements.description: Notify users via email or push notification when their account is locked, limited, or when suspicious activity is detected, with clear steps to resolve the issue.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive a notification within 5 minutes of an account lock or limitation.
The notification includes a link to a support page with steps to resolve the issue.
Users can contact support directly from the notification.

requirements.title: Provide clear data deletion and export options
requirements.description: Allow users to easily request deletion of their personal data and export their data in a portable format, addressing privacy and data security concerns.
acceptance_criteria: Users can find the data deletion and export options in the privacy settings.
Data export is available in a common format (e.g., JSON, CSV) within 24 hours of request.
Data deletion is processed within 30 days and confirmed to the user.

requirements.title: Simplify app interface for easier navigation
requirements.description: Redesign the main navigation and screens to reduce complexity, making it intuitive for users to find and use core features.
acceptance_criteria: The main navigation has at most 5 primary items, clearly labeled.
Users can complete a core task (e.g., adding a metro card) in under 3 minutes without assistance.
A usability test with 5 participants shows a 50% reduction in navigation errors compared to the current version.

requirements.title: Complete dark mode support across all screens
requirements.description: Ensure all pages, including web views and modals, respect the system dark mode setting, and provide a manual toggle in settings.
acceptance_criteria: All screens, including modals and web views, display dark backgrounds and light text when dark mode is enabled.
A manual dark mode toggle is available in Settings and overrides the system setting.
Automated UI tests verify that no screen has a light background in dark mode.

requirements.title: Fix missing UI elements after updates
requirements.description: Investigate and fix the issue where the bottom dock or menu bar disappears after app updates, ensuring consistent UI presence.
acceptance_criteria: After updating from the previous version, the bottom dock and menu bar are visible on all supported devices.
Regression tests cover the update path from at least two previous versions.
No crash or missing UI element is reported in beta testing for the update scenario.

requirements.title: Improve compatibility with older iOS versions and iPad landscape
requirements.description: Ensure the app functions correctly on older iOS versions and supports iPad landscape mode, including dark mode icons.
acceptance_criteria: The app runs without crashes on iOS 14 and later.
All screens render correctly in iPad landscape orientation with no overlapping elements.
Dark mode icons are provided for all system icons and are visible in both light and dark modes.

requirements.title: Simplify homepage by removing unwanted features
requirements.description: Redesign the homepage to declutter by removing or hiding short videos, red backgrounds, and message boxes, providing a cleaner and more user-friendly interface.
acceptance_criteria: The homepage no longer displays short videos, red backgrounds, or message boxes by default.
Users can access core features within two taps from the homepage.
A user survey or usability test shows a satisfaction score increase of at least 20% compared to the previous version.

requirements.title: Improve interface design and screen adaptation
requirements.description: Enhance the interface design to properly adapt to various screen sizes and ensure complete English localization for all UI elements.
acceptance_criteria: The app layout renders correctly on all supported device sizes without overlapping or cut-off elements.
All user-facing text is fully translated into English with no untranslated strings.
Automated layout tests pass for at least 5 common screen sizes.

requirements.title: Add dark mode support
requirements.description: Introduce a dark mode option that adjusts the color scheme to reduce eye strain and improve usability in low-light environments.
acceptance_criteria: Users can toggle dark mode from the settings menu.
Dark mode is applied consistently across all screens and components.
Contrast ratios in dark mode meet WCAG AA standards for text readability.

requirements.title: Improve payment error messaging
requirements.description: Provide clear, actionable error messages when a payment fails, including reasons such as insufficient funds, card declined, or network issues, and guide users on next steps.
acceptance_criteria: When a payment fails, the user sees a specific error message explaining the reason (e.g., 'Card declined', 'Insufficient funds').
The error message includes a suggested action, such as 'Try a different payment method' or 'Contact your bank'.
The error message is displayed within 2 seconds of the failure and is dismissible.

requirements.title: Enhance card linking and verification flow
requirements.description: Improve the card linking process to reduce errors and provide clear guidance when verification fails, including steps to resolve common issues.
acceptance_criteria: When a card linking attempt fails, the user sees a specific error message indicating the reason (e.g., 'Invalid card number', 'Card not supported').
The flow provides a 'Need help?' link that opens a help article with troubleshooting steps.
The user can retry linking without re-entering all card details if the failure is due to a temporary network issue.

requirements.title: Prevent payment denials after multiple transactions
requirements.description: Implement logic to detect and prevent payment denials that occur after a few successful transactions, possibly due to fraud detection or account restrictions, and provide clear communication to users.
acceptance_criteria: If a payment is denied after a series of successful transactions, the user receives a notification explaining the reason and how to resolve it (e.g., 'Verify your identity').
The system automatically flags accounts that show patterns of repeated denials for review.
The user can contact support directly from the error screen to resolve the issue.

requirements.title: Stabilize payment processing performance
requirements.description: Improve the reliability of payment processing to reduce random failures and ensure consistent transaction completion.
acceptance_criteria: The payment success rate for completed transactions is at least 99.5% over a 30-day period.
No more than 0.5% of payment attempts result in an unexpected error (e.g., timeout, server error).
The app retries failed payment requests automatically up to 3 times before showing an error to the user.

requirements.title: Fix payment and top-up failures
requirements.description: Resolve issues where users experience failures or limitations when making payments or topping up funds, including problems with coupons and TourPass. Ensure all payment methods work reliably without errors.
acceptance_criteria: Users can complete payments and top-ups without encountering errors or limitations.
Coupon and TourPass redemption works without failures.
No payment-related error messages appear during the transaction flow.

requirements.title: Enable credit and debit card linking
requirements.description: Allow users to successfully link credit or debit cards to their accounts for payment. Fix any issues preventing card linking.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add a credit or debit card without errors.
Linked cards appear in the user's payment methods.
Card linking works for supported card types and regions.

requirements.title: Improve international card support
requirements.description: Enhance payment processing to support international credit and debit cards, especially for US users. Address issues with adding cards and making payments with international cards.
acceptance_criteria: International cards can be added and used for payments without errors.
US users can complete transactions with their international cards.
No 'transaction error' or 'system error' messages appear for international cards.

requirements.title: Resolve transaction and system errors
requirements.description: Fix the 'transaction error' and 'system error' messages that users encounter when using international credit cards or making payments. Ensure error-free payment processing.
acceptance_criteria: Users do not see 'transaction error' or 'system error' messages during payment.
Payments with international cards complete successfully.
Error handling provides clear and helpful messages if issues occur.

requirements.title: Fix location accuracy in mini-programs
requirements.description: Improve the location accuracy feature within mini-programs to ensure precise user location detection, addressing user complaints about incorrect location data.
acceptance_criteria: Location accuracy within mini-programs is within 10 meters of actual user location in 95% of test cases.
The mini-program location API returns correct coordinates when tested in urban and rural environments.
No regression in location accuracy for standard app features.

requirements.title: Add option to disable IPv6
requirements.description: Provide users with the ability to disable IPv6 in network settings, addressing the issue where users cannot turn off IPv6 as reported.
acceptance_criteria: A toggle for IPv6 is available in the network settings menu.
When IPv6 is disabled, the app uses IPv4 for all network connections.
The setting persists across app restarts and is clearly labeled.

requirements.title: Implement in-app support chat
requirements.description: Add an in-app chat feature that allows users to contact customer support directly without leaving the app, with a response time guarantee and the ability to attach screenshots or transaction details.
acceptance_criteria: Users can initiate a chat from the help section within two taps.
Chat messages are acknowledged within 5 minutes during business hours.
Users can attach screenshots or transaction IDs to the chat.
Chat transcripts are saved and accessible for future reference.

requirements.title: Provide self-service resolution options
requirements.description: Create a comprehensive FAQ and troubleshooting section that addresses common issues such as account verification, transaction problems, and account restrictions, with step-by-step guides and direct links to relevant actions.
acceptance_criteria: FAQ covers at least 10 common issues with clear instructions.
Users can search the FAQ and get relevant results within 3 seconds.
Each FAQ article includes a 'Contact Support' button if the issue is not resolved.
Users can rate the helpfulness of each FAQ article.

requirements.title: Improve support response quality
requirements.description: Implement a training program for support agents to ensure they provide accurate, empathetic, and timely resolutions, and add a feedback mechanism for users to rate their support interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Support agents complete a training module on conflict resolution and product knowledge.
After each support interaction, users are prompted to rate their satisfaction on a 1-5 scale.
Average support satisfaction rating is tracked and reported monthly.
Support tickets are resolved within 24 hours on average.

requirements.title: Add proactive communication for account issues
requirements.description: When an account is restricted or a transaction fails, send a push notification and email explaining the reason and providing clear steps to resolve the issue, including a direct link to support.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive a notification within 5 minutes of an account restriction or transaction failure.
The notification includes a brief reason and a link to a detailed explanation.
The detailed explanation includes step-by-step resolution instructions.
Users can contact support directly from the notification or explanation page.

requirements.title: Improve customer service accessibility
requirements.description: Enhance customer support channels to ensure users can easily reach support via phone and email, reducing response times and improving overall satisfaction.
acceptance_criteria: Phone support line is answered within 2 minutes during business hours.
Email support responds within 24 hours.
Provide an in-app chat option as an additional support channel.

requirements.title: Add in-app support ticket system
requirements.description: Implement a support ticket system within the app that allows users to submit issues and track their status, providing a transparent and efficient way to get help.
acceptance_criteria: Users can submit a support ticket from the app's help section.
Ticket status updates are visible to the user.
Average first response time for tickets is under 12 hours.

requirements.title: Display support contact information prominently
requirements.description: Make customer support contact details (phone, email, and hours) easily accessible within the app, ensuring users can find help without difficulty.
acceptance_criteria: Support contact information is visible on the main settings page.
Contact details are also shown on the help/FAQ page.
Users can reach the support page within two taps from the home screen.

requirements.title: Reduce frequency of ads and promotional pop-ups
requirements.description: Implement a cap on the number of ads and promotional pop-ups shown per session, and ensure they are non-intrusive and dismissible.
acceptance_criteria: Users see at most 2 ads or promotional pop-ups per session.
All ads and pop-ups can be dismissed with a single tap.
No ad or pop-up covers more than 30% of the screen.

requirements.title: Remove temporary icon changes and promotional badges
requirements.description: Stop changing the app icon for promotional events and remove promotional badges from the app icon.
acceptance_criteria: The app icon remains consistent across all updates and does not change for promotional events.
No promotional badges are displayed on the app icon.
Users who previously complained about icon changes can update the app without seeing a changed icon.

requirements.title: Eliminate misleading loan and payment prompts
requirements.description: Remove or redesign pop-ups that mislead users into signing up for loans or enabling password-free payments, ensuring clear consent and transparency.
acceptance_criteria: No pop-up for loans or password-free payments appears without explicit user action.
Any such prompt clearly states the terms and requires a deliberate opt-in.
Users can easily decline the prompt without being redirected to a sign-up page.

requirements.title: Provide an ad-free experience option
requirements.description: Offer users an option to purchase an ad-free experience or reduce ads through a subscription or one-time purchase.
acceptance_criteria: An option to purchase an ad-free experience is available in the app settings.
Once purchased, the user sees no ads or promotional pop-ups.
The purchase is clearly described and can be completed within the app.

requirements.title: Implement ad frequency capping
requirements.description: Limit the number of ads shown to users per session to reduce disruption.
acceptance_criteria: Users see at most 3 ads per session.
Ad frequency is configurable via remote settings.
No more than one pop-up ad per session.

requirements.title: Add option to disable promotional pop-ups
requirements.description: Provide users with a setting to turn off promotional pop-ups and non-essential notifications.
acceptance_criteria: A toggle in settings disables all promotional pop-ups.
The setting persists across app restarts.
Users can re-enable pop-ups at any time.

requirements.title: Reduce push notification frequency
requirements.description: Limit promotional push notifications to a maximum of one per week and provide granular control.
acceptance_criteria: Promotional push notifications are sent at most once per week.
Users can choose to disable promotional notifications entirely.
Notification preferences are accessible within two taps from settings.

requirements.title: Implement ad-free premium option
requirements.description: Offer an in-app purchase to remove all ads and promotional content for a better user experience.
acceptance_criteria: A premium purchase option is visible in the app settings.
After purchase, all ads and promotional pop-ups are removed.
The purchase is restored on reinstall or new device.

requirements.title: Introduce a streamlined payment-focused mode
requirements.description: Add a user-selectable mode that hides non-essential features such as AI, video, and ads, presenting a clean interface focused on core payment functionality. This mode should be easily accessible from settings and persist across sessions.
acceptance_criteria: A toggle labeled 'Payment Focus Mode' is available in the app settings.
When enabled, the home screen displays only payment-related actions and hides AI, video, and ad modules.
The selected mode persists after app restart and is applied consistently across all screens.

requirements.title: Add granular controls to disable non-essential features
requirements.description: Provide individual toggles in settings to allow users to disable specific non-essential features (e.g., AI assistant, video content, ads, mini apps) independently, giving users control over their experience.
acceptance_criteria: Settings page includes separate toggles for AI, video, ads, and mini apps.
Disabling a feature removes its entry points from the main navigation and home screen.
Changes take effect immediately without requiring an app restart.

requirements.title: Simplify onboarding to highlight core payment features
requirements.description: Revise the onboarding flow to emphasize the app's primary payment capabilities and de-emphasize secondary features, reducing initial clutter and setting clear expectations for new users.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding screens focus on payment setup and usage, with secondary features mentioned only briefly.
New users can complete onboarding in under 3 minutes.
A 'Skip' option is available to bypass non-essential feature introductions.

requirements.title: Introduce a simplified mode
requirements.description: Add a 'Simplified Mode' toggle in settings that hides advanced features and modules, presenting only core functionality to reduce clutter and improve performance.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Simplified Mode' toggle is available in the settings screen and persists across app restarts.
When enabled, the app hides at least 50% of non-core features and modules from the main navigation.
The app's startup time and UI responsiveness improve by at least 20% when Simplified Mode is on, as measured by performance tests.

requirements.title: Add feature customization options
requirements.description: Allow users to enable or disable individual features and modules from a dedicated 'Features' section in settings, giving them control over what appears in the app.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Features' section is accessible from settings, listing all optional features and modules with toggles.
Toggling a feature off removes it from the main interface and disables its background processes.
The selected feature configuration is saved and applied immediately without requiring an app restart.

requirements.title: Optimize app performance and reduce bloat
requirements.description: Refactor the app's codebase to remove unused code, optimize resource usage, and streamline the user interface to address complaints about slowness and clutter.
acceptance_criteria: The app's binary size is reduced by at least 15% compared to the previous version.
The average app launch time is reduced by at least 20% as measured on reference devices.
The main navigation screen shows only essential features by default, with advanced features accessible via a 'More' menu.

requirements.title: Support older iOS versions
requirements.description: Ensure the app remains functional and visually consistent on older iOS versions (e.g., iOS 12 and below) by updating deployment target and testing on legacy devices.
acceptance_criteria: App launches without crashing on iOS 12 and iOS 13 simulators/devices.
All core features (login, payments, navigation) work on iOS 12 and iOS 13.
No UI elements are cut off or misaligned on older iOS versions.

requirements.title: Add dark mode icon support
requirements.description: Provide app icons that adapt to dark mode, ensuring visibility and aesthetic consistency when the device is in dark mode.
acceptance_criteria: App icon displays correctly in both light and dark mode on iOS 13 and later.
Icon contrast meets accessibility guidelines (WCAG AA).
No visual artifacts or blurriness in dark mode icon.

requirements.title: Support iPad landscape mode
requirements.description: Ensure the app layout adapts properly to iPad landscape orientation, providing a usable and visually pleasing experience.
acceptance_criteria: App rotates to landscape on iPad without layout distortion.
All interactive elements (buttons, forms) are reachable and functional in landscape.
No content is clipped or hidden in landscape mode.

requirements.title: Fix crash on launch after updates
requirements.description: Investigate and resolve crashes that occur immediately after app updates, particularly on specific devices or iOS versions, to ensure a stable launch experience.
acceptance_criteria: App launches successfully on all supported iOS versions after an update.
No crash reports from users within 24 hours of update release.
Crash rate post-update is below 0.1% of active users.

requirements.title: Resolve UI adaptation issues on newer devices
requirements.description: Fix UI elements that are misaligned or not properly scaled on newer iPhone models (e.g., iPhone X and later) to ensure a consistent user experience.
acceptance_criteria: UI elements are properly aligned and scaled on iPhone X, XS, 11, 12, 13, and 14.
No overlapping or cut-off text/buttons on any supported device.
Screenshots from automated UI tests show no visual defects.

requirements.title: Add Face ID support for payments
requirements.description: Integrate Face ID authentication for payment transactions on devices that support it, matching competitor functionality and improving user convenience.
acceptance_criteria: Users can enable Face ID for payment authorization in settings.
Payment confirmation via Face ID works on iPhone X and later.
Face ID authentication fails gracefully with fallback to passcode.

requirements.title: Provide clear update guidance for compatibility
requirements.description: When a user's device is incompatible with the current app version, display a clear message explaining the need to update and provide a direct link to the app store for the latest version.
acceptance_criteria: A compatibility warning screen appears when the app detects an outdated version on a newer device.
The warning includes a button that opens the app store page for the app.
The warning text clearly states that an update is required for compatibility.

requirements.title: Implement graceful degradation for older devices
requirements.description: For users who cannot update due to device limitations, ensure the app remains functional with reduced features rather than crashing or becoming unusable.
acceptance_criteria: The app launches without crashing on devices running older OS versions.
Core features remain accessible while advanced features are disabled with a notice.
A message informs the user about limited functionality and suggests updating if possible.

requirements.title: Highlight app convenience and trustworthiness in onboarding
requirements.description: Enhance the onboarding flow to emphasize the app's convenience and trustworthiness, addressing positive feedback from users who appreciate these aspects.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding screens include a section highlighting convenience and trustworthiness.
The feature is visible within the first three screens of onboarding.
A user can complete onboarding without skipping the highlighted section.

requirements.title: Improve initial verification process to maintain reliability perception
requirements.description: Streamline the initial verification process to reduce friction while preserving the app's reliability, as users appreciate reliability after initial verification.
acceptance_criteria: The verification process requires no more than two steps.
Users can complete verification within 2 minutes on average.
Error messages during verification are clear and provide guidance.

requirements.title: Showcase diverse services and customer service in app highlights
requirements.description: Add a section in the app that highlights the diverse services and customer service quality, leveraging positive feedback from users.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Services' section is accessible from the home screen within two taps.
The section lists at least three distinct services.
Customer service contact information is visible in the section.

requirements.title: Enhance ease-of-use features based on positive feedback
requirements.description: Build on the app's ease of use by refining navigation and overall functionality to maintain user satisfaction.
acceptance_criteria: The main navigation menu is reachable within one tap from any screen.
Common tasks (e.g., search, settings) can be completed in three or fewer taps.
User satisfaction score for ease of use increases by 5% in post-release survey.

requirements.title: Enhance translation feature visibility and accuracy
requirements.description: Improve the translation feature to ensure it is easily accessible and provides accurate translations, as users have positively mentioned translation capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The translation feature is accessible within two taps from the main screen.
Translation accuracy is rated at least 4 out of 5 in user testing.
The translation feature supports all languages currently listed in the app store description.

requirements.title: Optimize sticker functionality and discoverability
requirements.description: Enhance the sticker feature to make it more discoverable and user-friendly, as users have positively mentioned stickers in their reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Stickers are accessible from the main chat interface within one tap.
A new sticker pack is added and promoted in the app's 'What's New' section.
User engagement with stickers increases by 10% within one month of release.

requirements.title: Maintain and highlight overall usability and convenience
requirements.description: Continue to prioritize usability and convenience in the app, as users have positively noted these aspects. Ensure that any new features do not compromise the app's ease of use.
acceptance_criteria: The app's user interface remains consistent with the current design guidelines.
No new feature increases the average time to complete a core task by more than 5%.
User satisfaction scores for usability remain above 4 out of 5 in post-release surveys.

requirements.title: Address negative feedback to prevent regression
requirements.description: While users appreciate the app's convenience, there are negative reviews that may indicate areas for improvement. Proactively address common issues to maintain a positive experience.
acceptance_criteria: A list of top 10 issues from negative reviews is compiled and prioritized.
At least 3 of the top issues are addressed in this version.
The app's overall rating in the App Store does not decrease after this release.

requirements.title: Highlight positive user experiences in app store listing
requirements.description: Update the app store listing to showcase positive user feedback, emphasizing convenience, ease of use, and safety for daily transactions in China.
acceptance_criteria: App store description includes at least one quote from a positive review highlighting convenience or safety.
App store screenshots or promotional text emphasize ease of use for daily transactions in China.
The updated listing is reviewed and approved by the marketing team.

requirements.title: Add in-app feedback mechanism for positive experiences
requirements.description: Introduce a lightweight in-app prompt that encourages satisfied users to leave a positive review, helping to balance the overall rating and reinforce trust.
acceptance_criteria: The prompt appears only after a user has completed a successful transaction or used the app for at least 5 minutes.
The prompt can be dismissed and does not appear more than once per month per user.
The prompt links directly to the App Store review page.

requirements.title: Improve trust signals in app interface
requirements.description: Enhance the app's interface with trust indicators such as security badges, clear privacy policy links, and transparent transaction confirmations to address mixed opinions on reliability.
acceptance_criteria: A security badge or 'Secure' indicator is visible on the main payment screen.
A link to the privacy policy is accessible within two taps from the home screen.
Transaction confirmation screens include a clear summary of the transaction details and a 'Report an Issue' option.

requirements.title: Provide localized support and resources for China users
requirements.description: Add a help center section with localized FAQs and contact options for users in China, addressing common setup and usage questions to reinforce positive experiences.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Help' section is added to the app's main menu with at least 5 localized FAQs.
Contact options include email and in-app chat support.
The help content is available in both English and Chinese.

requirements.title: Add WeChat Pay as a payment option
requirements.description: Integrate WeChat Pay as an additional payment method within the app to accommodate users who prefer it, especially in regions where WeChat Pay is widely used.
acceptance_criteria: WeChat Pay appears as a selectable payment method in the payment settings and checkout flow.
Users can complete a transaction using WeChat Pay without errors.
The payment method is available in all regions where the app is offered.

requirements.title: Fix technical glitches and system errors
requirements.description: Address reported technical issues such as glitches, blank pages, and system errors that hinder app functionality, ensuring a stable and smooth user experience.
acceptance_criteria: No blank pages or system error messages appear during normal app usage in a test environment.
The app does not crash or freeze during core user flows (e.g., login, navigation, payment).
All reported glitches are resolved and verified through regression testing.

requirements.title: Improve location accuracy for third-party services
requirements.description: Enhance location accuracy when using third-party services like Didi to prevent navigation problems and improve user trust.
acceptance_criteria: Location coordinates provided to third-party services are accurate within a reasonable margin (e.g., 10 meters) in urban areas.
Users do not report navigation issues related to location in a post-release survey.
The app correctly requests and uses location permissions for third-party integrations.

requirements.title: Enhance international user experience
requirements.description: Improve usability for international users by addressing issues such as lack of passport verification, failure outside China, and overall unfriendliness to overseas users.
acceptance_criteria: International users can complete registration and verification using passport or other accepted international documents.
The app functions correctly outside China without errors or restrictions.
User interface and support materials are available in English and other major languages.

requirements.title: Expand app availability to more countries
requirements.description: Make the app available and functional in additional countries to support international users, addressing the limitation that the app is not accessible in certain regions.
acceptance_criteria: The app can be downloaded and launched in at least 10 new countries not previously supported.
Core features such as login and basic navigation work without errors in those countries.
A country selection or automatic detection mechanism is implemented to tailor the experience.

requirements.title: Remove foreign user restrictions for payment and verification
requirements.description: Allow foreign users to use the app without requiring Chinese bank cards or ID, and ensure the international version does not demand Chinese banking information.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign users can complete registration and verification using non-Chinese identification methods.
Payment options include international credit/debit cards and other non-Chinese payment methods.
The international version of the app does not prompt for Chinese bank card or ID during onboarding.

requirements.title: Improve Sesame Credit score increase transparency
requirements.description: Provide clearer information about how Sesame Credit scores are calculated and how users can improve them, addressing user frustration with frequent updates and diminishing score increases.
acceptance_criteria: A help section or FAQ explains the factors affecting the Sesame Credit score.
Users receive notifications or explanations when score updates occur, including reasons for changes.
The app provides actionable tips for improving the score, such as completing specific tasks.

requirements.title: Enable international spending and usage
requirements.description: Allow users to use the app for payments and services while abroad, removing the restriction that limits usage to mainland China.
acceptance_criteria: Users can make payments or use app services in at least 5 foreign countries.
The app displays appropriate currency conversion and transaction fees for international use.
A user traveling abroad can access and use the app without errors or location-based blocks.

requirements.title: Provide clear information and resolution for social feature restrictions
requirements.description: When users encounter restrictions on social features like adding friends or sending messages, display a clear explanation of the reason and provide an easy way to appeal or lift the restriction.
acceptance_criteria: When a user attempts a restricted action, a message explains the restriction reason and provides a link to appeal.
The appeal process is accessible within two taps from the restriction message.
If the restriction is lifted, the user is notified and can immediately use the feature.

requirements.title: Disclose all service fees upfront
requirements.description: Before any transaction, clearly display all applicable service fees, including any percentage-based usage fees, in addition to bank charges, so users are not surprised.
acceptance_criteria: The fee breakdown is shown on the transaction confirmation screen before finalizing.
The total amount including all fees is displayed in the local currency.
A tooltip or help icon explains each fee component.

requirements.title: Improve sign-up address input and loading states
requirements.description: Enhance the address input during sign-up to recognize various formats and prevent endless loading by adding validation and timeout handling.
acceptance_criteria: Address input accepts multiple formats (e.g., street, PO box, international) without errors.
If address validation takes longer than 5 seconds, show a loading indicator with a timeout message.
The sign-up process completes without getting stuck on the address step.

requirements.title: Provide migration path for chat history and widget alternatives
requirements.description: Offer a way for users to migrate their chat history when updating the app, and provide alternative widgets or a clear explanation for removed widgets.
acceptance_criteria: Users can export or transfer chat history to the new version within the app settings.
If a widget is removed, a notification explains the removal and suggests alternatives.
The migration process is completed within 10 minutes for typical chat histories.

requirements.title: Enhance transaction record reliability and clarity
requirements.description: Improve the reliability and clarity of transaction records and billing statements to address user concerns about their accuracy and trustworthiness.
acceptance_criteria: Transaction records display accurate and up-to-date information within 24 hours of a transaction.
Billing statements include a clear breakdown of charges, taxes, and any adjustments.
Users can access a help section explaining how to verify transaction records and report discrepancies.

requirements.title: Restore and preserve existing features during updates
requirements.description: Ensure that app updates do not remove or break existing features, specifically bus stop information and widgets, which users have reported as missing or non-functional after updates.
acceptance_criteria: Bus stop information remains accessible and accurate after each update.
Widgets continue to function correctly and display up-to-date information after updates.
A regression test suite covers all existing features before each release to prevent feature loss.

requirements.title: Strengthen privacy protections and transparency
requirements.description: Address user concerns about the app's respect for privacy by enhancing privacy protections and providing clear information about data usage.
acceptance_criteria: Privacy policy is easily accessible within the app and clearly explains data collection and usage.
Users can opt out of non-essential data collection through settings.
The app does not request unnecessary permissions; any permission requests are accompanied by a clear explanation.

requirements.title: Fix feedback and survey interface errors
requirements.description: Resolve issues with the feedback/survey interface that cause errors such as 'questionnaire does not exist' and server busy messages, ensuring users can successfully submit feedback.
acceptance_criteria: The feedback/survey interface loads without errors in all supported environments.
Users can successfully submit feedback without encountering 'questionnaire does not exist' or server busy messages.
Error handling provides clear and helpful messages if the service is temporarily unavailable.

requirements.title: Allow users to hide or dismiss persistent homepage elements
requirements.description: Provide users with the ability to hide or dismiss persistent elements like the '五福' banner on the homepage, even when switching modes, to give them more control over their interface.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Hide' or 'Dismiss' option is available on the persistent banner when it appears.
Once hidden, the banner does not reappear during the current session.
The user's preference is saved across sessions.

requirements.title: Provide option to skip forced updates for basic features
requirements.description: Allow users to continue using basic features like scanning without being forced to update the app, and provide an option to rollback to a previous version if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Users can dismiss the update prompt and continue using the current version.
Basic features such as scanning remain functional without updating.
A 'Rollback to previous version' option is available in settings.

requirements.title: Restore lock screen widgets
requirements.description: Reintroduce lock screen widgets that were removed in a recent update, as users have expressed disappointment over their removal.
acceptance_criteria: Lock screen widgets are available for key features such as scanning and status.
Widgets can be added and customized from the widget gallery.
The widgets function correctly on supported iOS versions.

requirements.title: Improve overall user satisfaction by addressing vague complaints
requirements.description: Investigate and address common issues that lead to strong dissatisfaction, even when users do not provide specific details, by improving overall app stability and performance.
acceptance_criteria: App crash rate is reduced by at least 20% compared to the previous version.
Average app launch time is reduced by at least 15%.
User rating for overall satisfaction improves by at least 0.5 stars in the next review cycle.

requirements.title: Make precise location access optional
requirements.description: Allow users to use the app without enabling precise location access. Provide an option to use approximate location or skip location permission entirely, with a clear explanation of why location is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Users can proceed with the app without granting precise location access.
A prompt appears explaining the benefits of precise location and offering alternatives.
The app functions correctly when only approximate location is granted.

requirements.title: Improve overall user satisfaction
requirements.description: Address general dissatisfaction by enhancing app performance, usability, and reliability. Conduct a thorough review of core features to identify and fix common issues that lead to negative feedback.
acceptance_criteria: App crash rate is reduced by at least 20% within the next release.
Average user rating improves by at least 0.5 stars within two months.
No critical bugs are reported in the top 10 user flows.

requirements.title: Fix false network connection errors
requirements.description: Investigate and resolve instances where the app incorrectly reports network connection errors even when the user has a stable internet connection. Ensure error messages are accurate and only shown when there is a genuine connectivity issue.
acceptance_criteria: No false network error messages appear when the device has a working internet connection.
Network error messages include a 'Retry' button and a 'Check Connection' diagnostic.
The app automatically retries failed requests without user intervention.

requirements.title: Reduce frequency of update pop-ups
requirements.description: Limit the number of in-app update notifications to avoid annoying users. Show update prompts at most once per session and provide a 'Remind Me Later' option that delays the prompt for a reasonable period.
acceptance_criteria: Update pop-ups appear at most once per app session.
A 'Remind Me Later' option is available and delays the prompt for at least 24 hours.
Users can dismiss the update prompt permanently from the settings.

requirements.title: Address ethical concerns and improve brand trust
requirements.description: Implement measures to address user concerns about company ethics and culture, including a public statement and internal policy review.
acceptance_criteria: A public statement addressing the ethical concerns is published on the company website and in the app's news section.
Internal policies are updated to prevent similar issues, with a summary available to users.
User sentiment in reviews improves by at least 10% within 3 months of the update.

requirements.title: Improve support for foreign users
requirements.description: Expand service availability and payment options to support foreign users, including accepting foreign credit cards and providing localized content.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign credit cards are accepted for all in-app purchases.
App content is localized for at least 5 additional languages.
Foreign users can access all features without encountering service restrictions.

requirements.title: Add rotation support and improve usability
requirements.description: Add support for screen rotation and enhance overall usability based on user feedback.
acceptance_criteria: The app supports both portrait and landscape orientations on all supported devices.
Usability improvements are implemented, such as larger touch targets and clearer navigation.
No regression in app performance or stability is observed after the update.

requirements.title: Fix reported bugs and error codes
requirements.description: Investigate and fix the specific error codes and bugs reported by users to ensure app functionality.
acceptance_criteria: The reported error codes are resolved and no longer appear in user sessions.
The specific bugs are fixed and verified through regression testing.
User reports of these errors decrease by at least 50% within one month of the update.

requirements.title: Fix push notification delivery for app features
requirements.description: Ensure that users who have enabled reminders for features like 'Ant Forest' actually receive push notifications. Investigate and resolve any issues causing notifications not to be delivered.
acceptance_criteria: Users who enable reminders for a feature receive a push notification within 5 minutes of a relevant event.
No more than 1% of users report missing notifications in a 30-day period.
Push notification settings are correctly saved and reflected in the app.

requirements.title: Improve handling of vague user complaints
requirements.description: Implement a mechanism to collect more specific feedback from users who leave vague complaints, such as prompting for additional details or categorizing common issues.
acceptance_criteria: When a user submits a review with less than 20 characters, the app prompts them to provide more details.
The app categorizes vague complaints into at least 5 predefined categories for better tracking.
The percentage of vague reviews decreases by 20% within 3 months of implementation.

requirements.title: Clarify credit and loan service terms
requirements.description: Add clear, transparent information about credit and loan services, including interest rates, repayment terms, and risks, to address user distrust and concerns.
acceptance_criteria: A 'Credit Services' section is accessible from the main menu, explaining terms in plain language.
Users must acknowledge the terms before using any credit or loan feature.
The app displays a warning about financial risks when users first access credit services.

requirements.title: Support foreign and non-Chinese payment methods
requirements.description: Add support for international payment methods such as Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal to allow non-Chinese users to make payments.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add a foreign credit card or PayPal account in the payment settings.
A test transaction with a foreign payment method completes successfully.
The payment method selection screen shows all supported international options.

test_cases.title: Verify alternative verification methods are offered when SMS fails
steps: Start registration or login flow on the app.
Enter a phone number that cannot receive SMS (e.g., international number).
Trigger SMS verification and wait for failure.
Observe the screen for alternative verification options.
test_cases.expected_result: When SMS verification fails, the app displays a clear error message and offers at least one alternative verification method (e.g., email or call) on the same screen.

test_cases.title: Verify alternative verification method completes registration or login
steps: Start registration or login flow.
Enter a phone number that cannot receive SMS.
When SMS fails, select an alternative verification method (e.g., email or call).
Complete the alternative verification process.
Confirm that registration or login is successful.
test_cases.expected_result: The alternative verification method successfully completes registration or login for users who cannot receive SMS.

test_cases.title: Verify clear error message and guidance when SMS fails
steps: Start registration or login flow.
Enter a phone number that cannot receive SMS.
Attempt to verify via SMS and wait for failure.
Observe the error message and any guidance provided.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a clear error message explaining the SMS failure and provides guidance directing users to alternative verification options.

test_cases.title: Verify alternative verification methods are accessible on the same screen
steps: Start registration or login flow.
Enter a phone number that cannot receive SMS.
When SMS fails, check if alternative verification options are visible on the same screen without navigating away.
test_cases.expected_result: Alternative verification methods (e.g., email or call) are presented on the same screen where SMS failure occurs, without requiring the user to navigate to a different screen.

test_cases.title: Verify alternative verification methods work for international users
steps: Start registration or login flow with an international phone number (e.g., non-US).
Attempt SMS verification and ensure it fails.
Select an alternative verification method (e.g., email or call).
Complete the alternative verification process.
Confirm successful registration or login.
test_cases.expected_result: International users who cannot receive SMS can successfully complete registration or login using an alternative verification method.

test_cases.title: Verify international credit card linking supports major brands
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment methods section.
Attempt to link a Visa card issued by an international bank.
Repeat the process with Mastercard and American Express cards.
Confirm that each card is successfully linked without errors.
test_cases.expected_result: Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards from international issuers are successfully linked without errors, covering at least 95% of major international card brands.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message when card linking fails due to unsupported card
steps: Navigate to the payment methods section.
Attempt to link a card from a less common international issuer that is not supported.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a specific error message indicating the card is not supported and suggests next steps, such as trying a different card type.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message when card linking fails due to address mismatch
steps: Navigate to the payment methods section.
Attempt to link a valid international card but enter a billing address that does not match the card's registered address.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a specific error message indicating an address mismatch and suggests verifying the billing address or contacting the bank.

test_cases.title: Verify transaction success rate for international users improves
steps: Set up a test environment with international user accounts.
Perform a series of transactions using international cards across various scenarios (e.g., different currencies, amounts).
Record the success rate of these transactions.
Compare the success rate with the baseline before the update.
test_cases.expected_result: The transaction success rate for international users increases by at least 20% compared to the baseline, meeting the acceptance criterion.

test_cases.title: Verify fallback options are available when card linking fails
steps: Navigate to the payment methods section.
Attempt to link a card that fails due to an unsupported card type.
Observe if the app provides fallback options such as using PayPal or bank transfer.
test_cases.expected_result: The app offers alternative payment methods (e.g., PayPal, bank transfer) when card linking fails, allowing the user to complete the setup.

test_cases.title: Verify error messages are clear and actionable for international users
steps: Simulate various card linking failures (unsupported card, address mismatch, expired card).
For each failure, read the error message and assess if it clearly explains the reason and provides next steps.
test_cases.expected_result: Each error message is specific, explains the reason for failure, and suggests actionable next steps, improving user understanding and reducing frustration.

test_cases.title: Verify passport chip scanning failure rate is reduced by at least 50%
steps: Open the app and start the identity verification process.
Attempt to scan a passport chip using the built-in scanner.
Repeat the scanning process multiple times with various passport types and lighting conditions.
Record the number of successful scans and failures.
test_cases.expected_result: The passport chip scanning failure rate is reduced by at least 50% compared to the previous version, with improved scanning algorithm and user guidance.

test_cases.title: Verify manual entry fallback when chip scanning fails
steps: Start the identity verification process.
Attempt to scan the passport chip and intentionally cause a failure (e.g., poor lighting or damaged chip).
When the scan fails, check if the app provides an option to manually enter passport details.
Select the manual entry option and complete the required fields.
Submit the manually entered details.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can manually enter passport details as a fallback when chip scanning fails, without needing to upload multiple times. The manual entry process is straightforward and allows completion of verification.

test_cases.title: Verify no 'server busy' errors during verification and automatic retry
steps: Start the identity verification process.
Simulate a temporary server error during the verification submission.
Observe the app's behavior.
Check if the app automatically retries the request and informs the user about the retry.
Complete the verification process.
test_cases.expected_result: The app does not show 'server busy' errors during verification. If a temporary error occurs, it automatically retries and informs the user, allowing the verification to complete without user frustration.

test_cases.verify: Verify verification process completes within 5 minutes for 90% of users
steps: Start the identity verification process on a device with a stable internet connection.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the verification, including scanning or manual entry.
Measure the time taken from start to completion.
Repeat the test with multiple users and network conditions.
Calculate the percentage of users who complete within 5 minutes.
test_cases.expected_result: The verification process can be completed within 5 minutes for 90% of users under normal conditions. The app provides clear instructions and efficient steps to minimize time.

test_cases.title: Verify clear instructions and error recovery during verification
steps: Start the identity verification process.
Intentionally make an error (e.g., blurry photo, incorrect manual entry).
Observe the error messages and instructions provided.
Follow the recovery steps suggested by the app.
Complete the verification successfully.
test_cases.expected_result: The app provides clear instructions and error recovery options, guiding users to correct mistakes without frustration. Error messages are helpful and actionable.

test_cases.title: Verify reduction in required personal information fields for foreign users
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the verification screen for a foreign user account.
Count the number of required personal information fields displayed.
Compare the count with the previous version's count (e.g., from documentation or baseline).
Attempt to submit the form without filling optional fields.
test_cases.expected_result: The number of required fields is reduced by at least 30% compared to the previous version. Optional fields are clearly marked and can be left blank without blocking submission.

test_cases.title: Verify each required field has an explanation tooltip
steps: Navigate to the verification screen for a foreign user.
For each required personal information field, hover over or tap the info icon next to the field.
Check that a tooltip or explanation appears stating why the information is needed.
test_cases.expected_result: Every required field displays a tooltip or explanation when the user interacts with the info icon, clearly stating the purpose of collecting that data.

test_cases.title: Verify optional fields are clearly marked and can be skipped
steps: Navigate to the verification screen for a foreign user.
Identify fields that are optional.
Check that each optional field is clearly labeled as 'Optional' or similar.
Leave all optional fields blank and submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: Optional fields are visibly marked as optional. The form can be submitted successfully without filling any optional fields, and no error is shown for missing optional data.

test_cases.title: Verify usability of explanations for required fields
steps: Navigate to the verification screen for a foreign user.
For each required field, locate the explanation tooltip.
Assess whether the explanation is clear, concise, and understandable to a non-technical user.
Check that the tooltip does not obscure the field or interfere with input.
test_cases.expected_result: Explanations are clear and easy to understand, helping users know why the information is needed. Tooltips appear without blocking the input fields and can be dismissed easily.

test_cases.title: Verify regression: existing verification flow still works for domestic users
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the verification screen for a domestic user account.
