steps: Simulate a high volume of concurrent requests to the system, including verification code requests and other typical operations.
Monitor the responses for any 'system busy' errors.
Count the total number of requests and the number of 'system busy' errors.
Calculate the error rate as (number of errors / total requests) * 100.
Repeat the test under varying load conditions to ensure consistency.
test_cases.expected_result: The system busy error rate is less than 1% of all requests. No 'system busy' errors are observed in the test run, or the calculated rate is below 1%.

test_cases.title: Verify no system busy errors in beta testing with 100 users
steps: Recruit a sample of 100 beta testers.
Have each tester perform typical actions that previously triggered system busy errors, such as requesting verification codes, logging in, and submitting forms.
Collect feedback from all testers regarding any system busy errors encountered.
Review the collected feedback for any reports of system busy errors.
test_cases.expected_result: No user reports of system busy errors are received from the 100 beta testers during the testing period.

test_cases.title: Verify error handling for verification code delivery failures
steps: Simulate a scenario where the verification code delivery service is temporarily unavailable or returns an error.
Attempt to request a verification code.
Observe the system's response and error handling.
Check that the user receives a clear and helpful error message instead of a system busy error.
Verify that the system retries the delivery automatically or provides a manual retry option.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a user-friendly error message indicating a temporary issue and provides a way to retry. No 'system busy' error is shown. The system handles the failure gracefully without crashing.

test_cases.title: Verify backend response time improvement for verification code requests
steps: Set up monitoring tools to measure the backend response time for verification code requests.
Send a series of verification code requests under normal load conditions.
Record the response times for each request.
Calculate the average response time and the 95th percentile response time.
Compare the results with the previous baseline (before the fix).
test_cases.expected_result: The average and 95th percentile response times for verification code requests are significantly improved compared to the baseline, meeting the 5-second delivery target.

test_cases.title: Verify no regression in verification code functionality
steps: Perform a full regression test on the verification code feature, including requesting, receiving, and using verification codes for account verification and password reset.
Test with various input formats (e.g., phone numbers with different country codes, email addresses).
Verify that the verification code is correctly generated, sent, and validated.
Check that the user can complete the intended action (e.g., account verification) successfully.
test_cases.expected_result: All verification code functionalities work as expected without any regression. Verification codes are delivered, accepted, and used correctly across all test scenarios.

test_cases.title: Verify app size reduction by at least 15%

Record the app size from the device settings.
Install the new version (v1.2.0) on the same device.
Record the app size from the device settings.
Calculate the percentage reduction in app size.
test_cases.expected_result: The app size of the new version is at least 15% smaller than the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify app launch time reduction by at least 20% on iPhone 11

Repeat the measurement 5 times and calculate the average launch time.
Compare the average launch time with the previous version's average launch time.
test_cases.expected_result: The average launch time of the new version is at least 20% faster than the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify smooth navigation between main screens in 95% of test cases

For each navigation action, observe if there is any visible lag, stutter, or delay.
Repeat the navigation sequence 20 times.
Count the number of navigation actions that are smooth without any visible lag.
test_cases.expected_result: At least 95% of the navigation actions (19 out of 20) are smooth with no visible lag.

test_cases.title: Verify UI elements render correctly on Apple Watch Series 6 and later

test_cases.expected_result: All UI elements render correctly without any display glitches, misalignment, or truncation on Apple Watch Series 6 and later.

Collect feedback on any display glitches or rendering issues.
Analyze the feedback to ensure no display glitches are reported.
test_cases.expected_result: No display glitches are reported by any of the 50 beta testers.

steps: Install the app on iPhone SE, iPhone 11, and iPhone 14 Pro Max.

test_cases.title: Verify display fixes do not introduce regressions on other devices

test_cases.expected_result: No regressions are introduced; all existing functionality works correctly and no new display issues appear on any supported device.

test_cases.title: Verify crash rate reduction after stability improvements

test_cases.title: Verify data usage reduction by at least 30% per session

test_cases.expected_result: The data usage per session is at least 30% lower than the baseline, demonstrating effective data compression and caching.

test_cases.title: Verify 'Low Data Mode' is available in settings

test_cases.title: Verify data compression does not break app functionality

test_cases.title: Verify text in English and other languages is fully visible without truncation
steps: Change the app language to English.
Navigate through all screens and check that all text labels, buttons, and messages are fully visible without being cut off or overlapping.
Change the app language to a language with longer text strings (e.g., German or French).
Repeat the navigation and check for any text truncation or overlap.
test_cases.expected_result: All text in English and other supported languages is fully visible without truncation or overlap on all supported devices.

test_cases.title: Verify layout adjusts for longer localized text strings
steps: Set the app language to a language with significantly longer strings (e.g., German).
Navigate to screens with buttons, labels, and alerts.
Check that the layout dynamically adjusts to accommodate the longer text without breaking the design or causing overlap.
test_cases.expected_result: The layout adjusts appropriately for longer localized text strings, maintaining a consistent and usable interface without any text being cut off or overlapping.

test_cases.title: Verify usability of interface on different screen sizes
steps: Use the app on an iPhone SE, iPhone 15 Pro Max, and iPad.
Perform common tasks such as signing in, browsing content, and making a purchase.
Evaluate whether touch targets are adequately sized and whether the interface is easy to navigate on each device.
test_cases.expected_result: The interface remains usable and intuitive on all tested screen sizes, with no usability issues such as too-small touch targets or difficult navigation.

test_cases.title: Verify no Chinese characters appear in UI when device language is English
steps: Set device language to English.
Launch the app.
Navigate through all main screens including home, settings, and any modal dialogs.
Capture screenshots of each screen.
test_cases.expected_result: No Chinese characters appear on any UI screen; all text is in English.

test_cases.title: Verify all UI text strings are externalized to localization files
steps: Inspect the app's source code or localization resource files.
Search for any hardcoded Chinese strings in the UI components.
Check that all user-facing strings are referenced from localization files.
test_cases.expected_result: All user-facing text strings are externalized to localization files; no hardcoded Chinese strings exist in the UI code.

test_cases.title: Verify localization review is completed for all user-facing screens
steps: Review the localization files for completeness.
Check that every user-facing screen has corresponding translations for English.
Verify that the translations are accurate and contextually appropriate.
test_cases.expected_result: All user-facing screens have complete and accurate English translations in the localization files.

test_cases.title: Verify simplified UI reduces task completion time for core features
steps: Open the app and navigate to a core feature (e.g., account settings).
Perform a typical task such as changing a profile setting.
Measure the time taken to complete the task.
Repeat the task with the updated UI.
test_cases.expected_result: Task completion time is reduced compared to the previous UI version, and the task is completed without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify UI elements are consistent with platform design guidelines
steps: Open the app on a supported platform (iOS or Android).
Navigate through all main screens and inspect UI elements such as buttons, icons, and navigation bars.
Compare the design with the platform's design guidelines (e.g., Apple HIG or Material Design).
test_cases.expected_result: All UI elements follow the platform's design guidelines, including spacing, typography, and interaction patterns.

test_cases.title: Verify no user feedback mentions confusion about the interface after the update
steps: Deploy the updated UI to a test group of international users.
Collect user feedback through in-app surveys or support channels.
Review feedback for any mentions of confusion or difficulty understanding the interface.
test_cases.expected_result: No user feedback mentions confusion about the interface; any feedback is positive or neutral regarding usability.

test_cases.title: Verify all features are accessible and functional in the US region
steps: Set the app locale to US (en-US).
Navigate through all main features of the app.
Attempt to use each feature and verify it loads and functions correctly.
Check that no feature is missing or broken due to region restrictions.
test_cases.expected_result: All features are accessible and functional in the US region without any errors or missing elements.

test_cases.title: Verify region-specific features are adapted or hidden for US users
steps: Set the app locale to US (en-US).
Identify any features that are region-specific (e.g., based on non-US regulations or content).
Check if these features are either adapted to US context or clearly hidden from the UI.
Verify that no irrelevant or non-functional features are shown to US users.
test_cases.expected_result: Region-specific features are either adapted to be relevant and functional for US users or are hidden from the UI, ensuring no broken or irrelevant features are visible.

test_cases.title: Verify no broken flows in the US locale
steps: Set the app locale to US (en-US).
Execute key user flows such as sign-up, login, purchase, and settings.
Monitor for any errors, crashes, or unexpected behavior.
Verify that all flows complete successfully without any broken steps.
test_cases.expected_result: All key user flows complete successfully in the US locale without any errors, crashes, or broken steps.

test_cases.title: Verify US users can access all features without encountering irrelevant content
steps: Set the app locale to US (en-US).
Browse through the app's main sections and content.
Check if any content or features are irrelevant to the US market (e.g., region-specific promotions, legal disclaimers).
Verify that such content is either adapted or not displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: US users do not encounter irrelevant or non-functional content; any region-specific content is adapted or hidden.

test_cases.title: Verify app performance remains stable in US locale
steps: Set the app locale to US (en-US).
Perform typical user actions such as loading pages, searching, and navigating.
Measure response times and check for any lag or performance degradation.
Verify that the app remains responsive and stable.
test_cases.expected_result: The app performs smoothly in the US locale with no significant performance degradation or stability issues.

test_cases.title: Verify suspension screen shows reason and contact support button
steps: Simulate an account suspension by triggering a policy violation or using a test account with suspended status.
Open the app and navigate to the screen that appears after suspension.
Check that the screen displays a clear explanation of the reason for suspension.
Verify that a 'Contact Support' button is visible on the screen.
test_cases.expected_result: The suspension screen clearly shows the reason for suspension and includes a 'Contact Support' button.

test_cases.title: Verify support contact is reachable within two taps from suspension notification
steps: Trigger an account suspension and receive the suspension notification.
From the notification, tap to open the suspension screen.
Count the number of taps required to reach the support contact method (e.g., chat, email, phone).
Ensure the support contact is accessible within two taps from the notification.
test_cases.expected_result: The support contact method is reachable within two taps from the suspension notification.

test_cases.title: Verify user can submit an appeal directly from suspension screen
steps: Trigger an account suspension and open the suspension screen.
Look for an option to submit an appeal or request for review.
Tap the appeal option and complete the required fields.
Submit the appeal and confirm that it is successfully sent.
test_cases.expected_result: The user can submit an appeal or request for review directly from the suspension screen, and the submission is successful.

test_cases.title: Verify suspension screen includes estimated resolution time or next steps
steps: Trigger an account suspension and open the suspension screen.
Review the content on the screen for any mention of estimated resolution time or next steps.
Check that the information is clear and helpful.
test_cases.expected_result: The suspension screen includes an estimated resolution time or clear next steps for the user.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy link is displayed on sign-up and verification screens
steps: Open the app and navigate to the sign-up screen.
Look for a link or text indicating the privacy policy.
Tap on the privacy policy link to ensure it opens a readable document.
Repeat the same steps on the verification screen.
test_cases.expected_result: A privacy policy link is clearly visible on both the sign-up and verification screens, and tapping it opens a readable privacy policy document.

test_cases.title: Verify each verification data point includes an explanation of why it is required
steps: Start the verification process.
For each data point requested (e.g., ID, address, photo), check if a brief explanation is displayed next to it.
Note any data point that lacks an explanation.
test_cases.expected_result: Every data point requested during verification is accompanied by a brief, clear explanation of why it is required.

test_cases.title: Verify Data Usage section in settings lists all collected data types and purposes
steps: Open the app settings.
Navigate to the 'Data Usage' section.
Review the list of data types and their purposes.
Check that the list is comprehensive and matches the data collected during sign-up and verification.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Data Usage' section in settings lists all collected data types and provides a clear purpose for each.

test_cases.title: Verify verification process does not request unnecessary permissions or data
steps: Start the verification process.
Review each permission or data request.
Determine if each request is essential for account security.
Attempt to complete verification without granting non-essential permissions.
test_cases.expected_result: The verification process only requests permissions and data that are essential for account security, and users can complete verification without granting unnecessary permissions.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy link is easily discoverable and readable on sign-up screen
steps: Open the sign-up screen.
Check if the privacy policy link is visible without scrolling.
Tap the link and verify the privacy policy is displayed in a readable format.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy link is prominently displayed on the sign-up screen without requiring scrolling, and the policy is readable.

test_cases.title: Verify explanations for data requests are clear and understandable to average users
steps: Start the verification process.
For each data request, read the explanation provided.
Assess whether the explanation is free of jargon and easy to understand for a non-technical user.
test_cases.expected_result: Explanations for each data request are clear, concise, and understandable to average users without technical background.

test_cases.title: Verify Data Usage section is easy to navigate and understand
steps: Open the app settings.
Navigate to the 'Data Usage' section.
Check if the information is organized in a clear and logical manner.
Verify that users can easily find the purpose of each data type.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Data Usage' section is well-organized, easy to navigate, and clearly explains the purpose of each data type.

test_cases.title: Verify that existing users can access the Data Usage section without issues
steps: Log in with an existing account.
Navigate to settings.
Open the 'Data Usage' section.
Confirm that the section loads correctly and displays the expected information.
test_cases.expected_result: Existing users can access the 'Data Usage' section without any errors, and it displays the list of collected data types and purposes.

test_cases.title: Verify that the privacy policy link is accessible from the verification screen
steps: Start the verification process.
Look for a privacy policy link on the verification screen.
Tap the link and verify it opens the privacy policy.
test_cases.expected_result: A privacy policy link is present on the verification screen and opens the privacy policy when tapped.

test_cases.title: Verify that the Data Usage section loads quickly
steps: Open the app settings.
Navigate to the 'Data Usage' section.
Measure the time it takes for the section to load and display the data.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Data Usage' section loads within an acceptable time (e.g., under 2 seconds) without noticeable delay.

test_cases.title: Verify push notification on new device login
steps: Log in to the app on a new device.
Check if a push notification is received on the primary device.
Tap the notification and verify it opens the recent account activity screen.
test_cases.expected_result: A push notification is sent when a new device logs in, and tapping it navigates to the recent account activity screen.

test_cases.title: Verify notification includes link to review recent account activity
steps: Log in to the app on a new device.
Receive the push notification.
Open the notification and verify it contains a link to review recent account activity.
Tap the link and confirm it opens the recent activity screen.
test_cases.expected_result: The push notification includes a link that opens the recent account activity screen.

test_cases.title: Verify Security Tips section is accessible from settings menu
steps: Open the app.
Navigate to the settings menu.
Look for a 'Security Tips' section.
Tap on it and verify it opens.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Security Tips' section is present in the settings menu and is accessible.

test_cases.title: Verify Security Tips section contains at least three articles
steps: Open the app.
Navigate to settings and open the 'Security Tips' section.
Count the number of articles displayed.
Verify that at least three articles are present.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Security Tips' section contains at least three articles about common scams and account protection.

test_cases.title: Verify security tips articles are relevant and readable
steps: Open the 'Security Tips' section from settings.
Open each article and verify the content is relevant to common scams and account protection.
Check that the articles are readable and well-formatted.
test_cases.expected_result: All articles in the 'Security Tips' section are relevant, readable, and provide useful information about scams and account protection.

test_cases.title: Verify notification is sent for password change
steps: Change the account password.
Check if a push notification is received on the primary device.
Open the notification and verify it provides information about the password change.
test_cases.expected_result: A push notification is sent when the password is changed, and it informs the user about the change.

test_cases.title: Verify notification is sent for login from new device after password change
steps: Change the account password.
Log in from a new device using the new password.
Check if a push notification is received on the primary device.
Verify the notification includes a link to review recent account activity.
test_cases.expected_result: A push notification is sent for the new device login, and it includes a link to review recent account activity.

test_cases.title: Verify security notifications are not sent for normal logins from known devices
steps: Log in from a device that has been used before.
Check if any push notification is received.
Verify that no notification is sent for logins from known devices.
test_cases.expected_result: No push notification is sent for logins from known devices, only for new devices.

test_cases.title: Verify security tips section is accessible offline
steps: Open the app.
Navigate to the 'Security Tips' section.
Disable internet connection.
Verify that the articles are still accessible and readable.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Security Tips' section remains accessible and articles are readable even without an internet connection.

test_cases.title: Verify notification link opens recent activity screen with correct data
steps: Log in from a new device.
Receive the push notification.
Tap the link in the notification.
Verify that the recent activity screen shows the new device login event.
test_cases.expected_result: The recent activity screen opens and displays the new device login event with correct details.

test_cases.title: Verify multiple support contact methods are available for account issues
steps: Open the app and navigate to the settings menu.
Look for a 'Support' or 'Help' section.
Check that at least two contact methods (e.g., email, in-app chat) are listed.
test_cases.expected_result: The support section displays at least two distinct contact methods for account-related issues.

test_cases.title: Verify expected response times are displayed in support section
steps: Navigate to the support section from the settings menu.
Review the displayed information for any mention of response time expectations.
test_cases.expected_result: The support section clearly shows an expected response time, such as 'We typically respond within 24 hours'.

test_cases.title: Verify support is accessible from account suspension screen
steps: Trigger an account suspension scenario (e.g., simulate a suspended account).
On the suspension screen, look for a link or button to contact support.
Tap the support link and confirm it opens the support options.
test_cases.expected_result: The account suspension screen provides a clear and accessible way to reach customer support.

test_cases.title: Verify support is accessible from settings menu
steps: Open the app and go to the settings menu.
Look for a 'Support' or 'Help' option.
Tap on it and confirm the support screen loads.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can access customer support from the settings menu without any issues.

test_cases.title: Verify support requests include a reference number for tracking
steps: Initiate a support request (e.g., submit a form or start a chat).
Complete the request submission.
Check the confirmation screen or email for a reference number.
test_cases.expected_result: Each support request is assigned a unique reference number that is shown to the user for tracking purposes.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is accessible from main settings menu within two taps
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the main settings menu.
Count the number of taps required to reach the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy is accessible from the main settings menu within two taps.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy lists all data types, purposes, and third-party sharing partners
steps: Open the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
Review the content for a clear list of all data types collected, the purposes for collection, and any third-party sharing partners.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy clearly lists all data types collected, the purposes for each, and all third-party sharing partners.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is available in English and Simplified Chinese with language selector
steps: Open the privacy policy.
Look for a language selector.
Switch between English and Simplified Chinese and verify the content is displayed correctly in each language.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy is available in at least English and Simplified Chinese, with a language selector that allows switching between them.

test_cases.title: Verify users must acknowledge privacy policy before any personal data is collected
steps: Install the app and launch it for the first time.
Attempt to proceed without acknowledging the privacy policy.
Check if any personal data is collected before acknowledgment.
test_cases.expected_result: A confirmation dialog appears requiring the user to acknowledge the privacy policy before any personal data is collected. If the user does not acknowledge, no data collection occurs.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is user-friendly and easy to understand
steps: Open the privacy policy.
Review the language and formatting for clarity and ease of understanding.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy is presented in a user-friendly format with clear language, headings, and bullet points, making it easy for users to understand.

test_cases.title: Verify consent screen appears before sensitive data entry
steps: Launch the app and navigate to a feature that requires sensitive data entry (e.g., passport details, face scan, or bank account information).
Attempt to enter the sensitive data.
Observe whether a dedicated consent screen appears before any data entry is allowed.
test_cases.expected_result: A dedicated consent screen appears before any sensitive data entry, explaining the specific purpose, data retention period, and user rights. The user must take explicit action (e.g., checkbox or button) to proceed.

test_cases.title: Verify user can decline consent and still use non-sensitive features
steps: Launch the app and navigate to a feature that requires sensitive data entry.
When the consent screen appears, choose to decline consent (e.g., click 'Decline' or uncheck the checkbox).
Attempt to use other non-sensitive features of the app.
test_cases.expected_result: The user can decline consent and still access and use all non-sensitive features of the app without any loss of core functionality. The app does not force the user to provide sensitive data to continue using non-sensitive features.

test_cases.title: Verify consent choices are recorded and can be reviewed or revoked in settings
steps: Provide consent for sensitive data entry in a feature.
Navigate to the app's settings.
Look for a section that lists consent choices.
Review the recorded consent for the sensitive data.
Attempt to revoke the consent.
test_cases.expected_result: The consent choice is recorded and visible in the settings. The user can review the consent details and revoke the consent at any time. After revocation, the app should respect the user's choice and not collect sensitive data without new consent.

test_cases.title: Verify consent screen includes link to full privacy policy
steps: Launch the app and navigate to a feature that requires sensitive data entry.
When the consent screen appears, look for a link to the privacy policy.
Tap the link and verify it opens the full privacy policy.
test_cases.expected_result: The consent screen includes a link to the full privacy policy. Tapping the link opens the complete privacy policy document, which is accessible and readable.

test_cases.title: Verify consent screen is clear and understandable for users
steps: Launch the app and navigate to a feature that requires sensitive data entry.
When the consent screen appears, review the text and layout.
Check that the purpose, retention period, and user rights are clearly explained in plain language.
Check that the consent action (e.g., checkbox or button) is clearly labeled and easy to understand.
test_cases.expected_result: The consent screen is clear and understandable, with plain language explaining the purpose, data retention period, and user rights. The consent action is clearly labeled and easy to identify. Users can make an informed decision without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify Security & Trust section is accessible from main menu
steps: Open the app and navigate to the main menu.
Look for a 'Security & Trust' section.
Tap on the 'Security & Trust' section.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Security & Trust' section is accessible from the main menu and opens successfully.

test_cases.title: Verify Security & Trust section contains at least five FAQ items
steps: Open the 'Security & Trust' section from the main menu.
Scroll through the content.
Count the number of FAQ items displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The section contains at least five FAQ items addressing common privacy concerns.

test_cases.title: Verify 'Contact Security Team' button opens support form or email
steps: Open the 'Security & Trust' section.
Locate the 'Contact Security Team' button.
Tap on the button.
test_cases.expected_result: Tapping the button opens a support form or email client with the appropriate recipient.

test_cases.title: Verify 'Request Data Deletion' option initiates verified process
steps: Open the 'Security & Trust' section.
Locate the 'Request Data Deletion' option.
Tap on the option.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the request.
test_cases.expected_result: The option initiates a verified process that guides the user through data deletion request, including identity verification.

test_cases.title: Verify Security & Trust content is localized in English and Chinese
steps: Change the app language to English.
Open the 'Security & Trust' section and verify all content is in English.
Change the app language to Chinese.
Open the 'Security & Trust' section and verify all content is in Chinese.
test_cases.expected_result: All content in the section is displayed correctly in both English and Chinese without missing translations or layout issues.

test_cases.title: Verify Security & Trust section is easy to navigate and understand
steps: Open the 'Security & Trust' section.
Review the layout, organization, and clarity of information.
Attempt to navigate to each FAQ item and the contact and deletion options.
test_cases.expected_result: The section is well-organized, easy to navigate, and the information is presented clearly without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify FAQ section for foreign users is available in English and Chinese
steps: Open the app and navigate to the consent screen.
Look for a link to the FAQ section for foreign users.
Click the link and verify the FAQ page loads.
Check that the FAQ is available in both English and Chinese.
test_cases.expected_result: A dedicated FAQ section for foreign users is accessible from the consent screen and is available in both English and Chinese.

test_cases.title: Verify FAQ explains legal basis for collecting sensitive data
steps: Open the FAQ section for foreign users.
Review the content for explanations about why personal data such as passport and bank account is required.
Check that the legal basis for collecting this data is clearly stated.
Verify that the FAQ explains how the data is used and protected.
test_cases.expected_result: The FAQ clearly explains the legal basis for collecting sensitive data, how it is used, and how it is protected.

test_cases.title: Verify FAQ includes contact information for privacy inquiries
steps: Open the FAQ section for foreign users.
Scroll through the content to find contact information for privacy inquiries.
Verify that the contact details are complete and accurate.
test_cases.expected_result: The FAQ includes contact information (e.g., email, address) for privacy inquiries.

test_cases.title: Verify FAQ is linked from consent screen and Security & Trust section
steps: Open the app and navigate to the consent screen.
Check for a link to the FAQ section for foreign users.
Click the link and verify it leads to the FAQ.
Navigate to the Security & Trust section in the app settings.
Verify that the FAQ is also linked from this section.
test_cases.expected_result: The FAQ section for foreign users is linked from both the consent screen and the Security & Trust section.

test_cases.title: Verify FAQ content addresses common concerns of foreign users
steps: Review the FAQ content for foreign users.
Check that it addresses common concerns such as why passport and bank account data is required, how it is protected, and any legal obligations.
Verify that the language is clear and easy to understand.
test_cases.expected_result: The FAQ content addresses common concerns of foreign users regarding data collection and protection, and is written in clear language.

test_cases.title: Verify user can enable two-factor authentication via SMS or authenticator app
steps: Open the app and navigate to Settings.
Select Account Security or similar option.
Choose Two-Factor Authentication.
Select SMS as the method and enter a valid phone number.
Complete the verification process.
Repeat steps 3-5 but select Authenticator App instead.
Confirm that 2FA is enabled.
test_cases.expected_result: User can successfully enable two-factor authentication using either SMS or an authenticator app. The app confirms the setup and requires the second factor on subsequent logins.

test_cases.title: Verify user can view and manage active sessions
steps: Log in to the app.
Navigate to Settings and select Account Security.
Open the Active Sessions or Sessions management screen.
Review the list of active sessions, including device and location details.
Select a session and revoke it.
Attempt to access the app from the revoked session.
test_cases.expected_result: The user can see all active sessions with relevant details. Revoking a session immediately terminates that session, and the user is prompted to log in again from that device.

test_cases.title: Verify user receives notification when a new device logs in
steps: Log in to the app from a new device or browser.
Check the email and push notifications associated with the account.
Open the notification and verify the details (device, location, time).
test_cases.expected_result: The user receives an email or push notification immediately after a new device logs in, containing details about the device and location. The notification is clear and actionable.

test_cases.title: Verify account suspension notification includes reason and appeal process
steps: Simulate an account suspension (e.g., via admin action or policy violation).
Check the notification sent to the user (email or in-app).
Review the content for a clear reason for suspension.
Look for an appeal process link or instructions.
Attempt to appeal the suspension.
test_cases.expected_result: The suspension notification clearly states the reason for the suspension and provides a straightforward appeal process. The user can submit an appeal and receive a confirmation.

test_cases.title: Verify 2FA setup is user-friendly and accessible
steps: Navigate to the 2FA setup screen.
Attempt to enable 2FA using both SMS and authenticator app methods.
Observe the clarity of instructions and ease of completing the process.
Check if the setup can be completed without external help.
test_cases.expected_result: The 2FA setup process is intuitive, with clear instructions and minimal steps. Users can complete it without confusion or errors.

test_cases.title: Verify session management screen is easy to understand
steps: Open the session management screen.
Review the list of active sessions.
Check if device names, locations, and last active times are clearly displayed.
Attempt to revoke a session and observe the confirmation process.
test_cases.expected_result: The session management screen presents information in a clear, organized manner. Users can easily identify and revoke sessions without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify security features do not break existing login flow
steps: Enable 2FA on an account.
Log out and attempt to log in using the standard credentials.
Complete the 2FA verification.
Repeat the process with a session that has been revoked.
test_cases.expected_result: The login flow works correctly with 2FA enabled. Revoked sessions are blocked, and valid sessions proceed without issues. No regression in the core login functionality.

test_cases.title: Verify security features perform within acceptable response times
steps: Enable 2FA and measure the time taken to complete the setup.
Log in with 2FA and measure the time from credential entry to successful authentication.
Open the session management screen and measure the load time.
Trigger a new device login notification and measure the time until the notification is received.
test_cases.expected_result: All security-related operations complete within acceptable response times (e.g., setup under 2 minutes, login under 10 seconds, session list under 3 seconds, notification within 1 minute). No noticeable performance degradation.

test_cases.title: Verify detailed explanation of verification requirements is shown before starting
steps: Open the app and navigate to the account verification section.
Look for a detailed explanation of verification requirements before starting the process.
Confirm that the explanation includes all necessary documents and steps.
test_cases.expected_result: A detailed explanation of verification requirements is displayed before the user starts the verification process, including all required documents and steps.

test_cases.title: Verify alternative verification method is offered for users without Chinese bank accounts
steps: Start the account verification process.
When prompted for a Chinese bank account, check if alternative verification methods are offered.
Select an alternative method such as passport or ID card and complete the verification.
test_cases.expected_result: At least one alternative verification method (e.g., passport, ID card) is offered for users without Chinese bank accounts, and the user can successfully complete verification using it.

test_cases.title: Verify verification process can be completed within 5 minutes on average
steps: Start the account verification process.
Measure the time taken from the start of the process to successful completion.
Repeat the process with multiple users to calculate the average time.
test_cases.expected_result: The average time to complete the verification process is 5 minutes or less.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is accessible within two taps from main settings menu
steps: Open the app and navigate to the main settings menu.
Look for a link or option to access the privacy policy.
Count the number of taps required to reach the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy is accessible within two taps from the main settings menu.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy includes a plain language summary section
steps: Open the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
Scroll through the policy content.
Look for a summary section that explains data collection and sharing in plain language.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy includes a summary section in plain language explaining data collection and sharing.

test_cases.title: Verify users can opt out of non-essential data sharing with third parties
steps: Open the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
Look for an option to manage data sharing preferences.
Attempt to opt out of non-essential data sharing with third parties.
Confirm the opt-out is saved and effective.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can opt out of non-essential data sharing with third parties, and the choice is saved and effective.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is easy to understand for average users
steps: Open the privacy policy from the main settings menu.
Read the summary section and key parts of the policy.
Assess whether the language is clear and free of complex legal jargon.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy uses easy-to-understand language, making it accessible to average users.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy policy is prominently accessible from settings
steps: Open the app and go to the main settings menu.
Check if the privacy policy link is clearly visible and not buried in submenus.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy policy is prominently accessible from the main settings menu, with a clear and visible link.

test_cases.title: Verify Privacy & Security section is available in app settings
steps: Open the app and navigate to the settings screen.
Look for a 'Privacy & Security' section in the settings menu.
Tap on the 'Privacy & Security' section.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Privacy & Security' section is present in the app settings and opens a screen that provides explanations for each permission the app uses.

test_cases.title: Verify list of permissions and purposes is displayed
steps: Open the app and navigate to the 'Privacy & Security' section in settings.
Review the list of permissions displayed.
Check that each permission has a corresponding purpose or explanation.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Privacy & Security' section shows a list of all permissions the app has requested, and each permission includes a clear explanation of why it is needed.

test_cases.title: Verify tutorial or tooltip appears when requesting sensitive permissions
steps: Start a process that requests a sensitive permission such as camera or contacts.

test_cases.expected_result: When the app requests a sensitive permission (e.g., camera, contacts), a tutorial or tooltip is shown to the user explaining the purpose of the permission before or during the request.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy and security information is easy to understand
steps: Open the 'Privacy & Security' section in settings.
Read the explanations for permissions and data usage.
Assess whether the language is clear and understandable for a typical user.
test_cases.expected_result: The privacy and security information is presented in clear, non-technical language that is easy for users to understand, addressing their privacy concerns.

test_cases.title: Verify privacy and security section is accessible from settings
steps: Open the app and go to the settings screen.
Navigate to the 'Privacy & Security' section.
Ensure the section is reachable within a few taps and is clearly labeled.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Privacy & Security' section is easily accessible from the main settings menu with a clear label, allowing users to find it without difficulty.

test_cases.title: Verify user receives notification within 5 minutes of account lock
steps: Simulate an account lock event for a test user.
Wait up to 5 minutes.
Check the user's email and push notification inbox.
test_cases.expected_result: The user receives an email or push notification within 5 minutes of the account lock event.

test_cases.title: Verify notification includes link to support page with resolution steps
steps: Trigger an account lock or limitation event.
Open the notification received by the user.
Click on the link provided in the notification.
test_cases.expected_result: The notification contains a link that directs the user to a support page with clear steps to resolve the account issue.

test_cases.title: Verify user can contact support directly from notification
steps: Trigger an account lock or limitation event.
Open the notification received by the user.
Look for and use the contact support option within the notification.
test_cases.expected_result: The notification provides a direct way for the user to contact support, such as a 'Contact Support' button or link.

test_cases.title: Verify notification is clear and actionable for users
steps: Trigger an account lock or limitation event.
Review the notification content from the user's perspective.
Assess if the notification clearly explains the issue and provides actionable steps.
test_cases.expected_result: The notification is clear, concise, and provides actionable steps for the user to resolve the account issue, reducing confusion and frustration.

test_cases.title: Verify notification delivery performance under load
steps: Simulate a high volume of account lock events (e.g., 1000 events).
Measure the time from event occurrence to notification delivery for each event.
Calculate the percentage of notifications delivered within 5 minutes.
test_cases.expected_result: At least 95% of notifications are delivered within 5 minutes under load, meeting the acceptance criteria.

test_cases.title: Verify data deletion and export options are accessible in privacy settings
steps: Open the app and navigate to the settings menu.
Select 'Privacy' or 'Privacy Settings'.
Look for options related to data deletion and data export.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can easily find both 'Delete My Data' and 'Export My Data' options within the privacy settings.

test_cases.title: Verify data export request produces a downloadable file in a common format within 24 hours
steps: Navigate to privacy settings and select 'Export My Data'.
Confirm the export request.
Wait for the export to be processed.
Check for a notification or download link.
Download the exported data file.
test_cases.expected_result: The user receives a downloadable file in a common format (e.g., JSON or CSV) within 24 hours of the request.

test_cases.title: Verify data deletion request is processed within 30 days and user is confirmed
steps: Navigate to privacy settings and select 'Delete My Data'.
Confirm the deletion request.
Wait for the deletion to be processed.
Check for a confirmation message or email.
test_cases.expected_result: The user's data is deleted within 30 days and the user receives a confirmation of the deletion.

test_cases.title: Verify data deletion and export options are clearly labeled and understandable
steps: Navigate to privacy settings.
Review the labels and descriptions for data deletion and export options.
test_cases.expected_result: The options are clearly labeled with plain language that users can understand, such as 'Delete My Data' and 'Export My Data'.

test_cases.title: Verify data export includes all user personal data in a portable format
steps: Initiate a data export request.
Wait for the export to complete.
Open the downloaded file.
Check that the file contains all personal data associated with the user account.
test_cases.expected_result: The exported file contains all personal data in a structured, portable format (e.g., JSON or CSV) that can be easily read by other systems.

test_cases.title: Verify data deletion removes all personal data from the system
steps: Initiate a data deletion request.
Wait for the deletion to be processed.
Attempt to log in or access the account.
Check if any personal data remains in the system.
test_cases.expected_result: After deletion, the user's personal data is completely removed from the system and the account is no longer accessible.

test_cases.title: Verify main navigation has at most 5 primary items
steps: Launch the app and go to the main navigation menu.
Count the number of primary navigation items displayed.
Verify each item is clearly labeled.
test_cases.expected_result: The main navigation displays at most 5 primary items, each with a clear label.

test_cases.title: Verify core task completion under 3 minutes
steps: Start a timer.
Navigate to add a metro card.
Complete the process of adding a metro card.
Stop the timer and record the elapsed time.
test_cases.expected_result: The user can add a metro card in under 3 minutes without assistance.

test_cases.title: Verify 50% reduction in navigation errors in usability test
steps: Conduct a usability test with 5 participants.
Ask participants to perform a set of core tasks.
Record the number of navigation errors each participant makes.
Compare the error count with the current version's baseline.
test_cases.expected_result: The usability test shows a 50% reduction in navigation errors compared to the current version.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode applies to all screens including modals and web views
steps: Enable dark mode in system settings.
Open the app and navigate through all main screens.
Open a modal dialog and a web view.
Check that all screens have dark backgrounds and light text.
test_cases.expected_result: All screens, including modals and web views, display dark backgrounds and light text when dark mode is enabled.

test_cases.title: Verify manual dark mode toggle in settings overrides system setting
steps: Open the app settings.
Locate the dark mode toggle.
Set the toggle to 'On' while system dark mode is off.
Verify the app switches to dark mode.
Set the toggle to 'Off' while system dark mode is on.
Verify the app switches to light mode.
test_cases.expected_result: The manual dark mode toggle in Settings overrides the system setting and changes the app appearance accordingly.

test_cases.title: Verify no screen has light background in dark mode via automated UI tests
steps: Run the automated UI test suite for dark mode.
Check that the test scans all screens, modals, and web views.
Verify that the test fails if any screen has a light background in dark mode.
test_cases.expected_result: Automated UI tests verify that no screen has a light background in dark mode.

test_cases.title: Verify bottom dock and menu bar are visible after app update
steps: Install the previous version of the app on a supported device.
Update the app to the current version.
Launch the app after the update.
Navigate to the main screen and check for the bottom dock and menu bar.
test_cases.expected_result: The bottom dock and menu bar are visible on the main screen after the update, with no missing UI elements.

test_cases.title: Verify bottom dock and menu bar visibility on all supported devices after update
steps: Prepare a list of all supported devices.
For each device, install the previous version of the app.
Update the app to the current version on each device.
Launch the app and check for the bottom dock and menu bar.
test_cases.expected_result: The bottom dock and menu bar are visible on all supported devices after the update, with no missing UI elements.

test_cases.title: Verify no crash or missing UI elements during beta testing of update scenario
steps: Enroll a group of beta testers.
Have beta testers update the app from the previous version to the current version.
Collect crash reports and UI feedback from beta testers.
Analyze the reports for any crashes or missing UI elements.
test_cases.expected_result: No crashes or missing UI elements are reported by beta testers during the update scenario.

test_cases.title: Verify app runs without crashes on iOS 14
steps: Install the app on a device running iOS 14.
Launch the app.
Navigate through all main screens and features.
test_cases.expected_result: The app launches and functions without any crashes on iOS 14.

test_cases.title: Verify iPad landscape rendering without overlapping elements
steps: Open the app on an iPad.
Rotate the device to landscape orientation.
Navigate through all screens and check for overlapping or misaligned elements.
test_cases.expected_result: All screens render correctly in iPad landscape orientation with no overlapping elements.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode icons are visible in light and dark modes
steps: Enable dark mode on the device.
Open the app and check all system icons.
Switch to light mode and check the icons again.
test_cases.expected_result: All system icons have dark mode variants and are clearly visible in both light and dark modes.

test_cases.title: Verify homepage no longer displays short videos, red backgrounds, or message boxes by default
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Observe the homepage for the presence of short videos, red backgrounds, or message boxes.
Check if any of these elements appear by default.
test_cases.expected_result: The homepage does not display short videos, red backgrounds, or message boxes by default. The interface appears clean and decluttered.

test_cases.title: Verify core features are accessible within two taps from the homepage
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Identify the core features (e.g., search, profile, settings, main content).
Attempt to access each core feature from the homepage, counting the number of taps required.
test_cases.expected_result: All core features can be accessed within two taps from the homepage. No feature requires more than two taps to reach.

test_cases.title: Verify user satisfaction score increases by at least 20% compared to previous version
steps: Prepare a usability test or survey with a satisfaction score metric (e.g., SUS or CSAT).
Recruit a representative sample of users.
Have users interact with the new homepage (v1.5.0) and rate their satisfaction.
Compare the average satisfaction score with the baseline from the previous version.
test_cases.expected_result: The average satisfaction score for the new homepage is at least 20% higher than the previous version's score.

test_cases.title: Verify that removing short videos, red backgrounds, and message boxes does not break existing functionality
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Verify that the homepage loads without errors.
Test core features such as navigation, search, and content access to ensure they still work.
Check that no error messages or crashes occur when interacting with the homepage.
test_cases.expected_result: The homepage loads successfully and all core features function correctly without any errors or crashes.

test_cases.title: Verify app layout renders correctly on various screen sizes
steps: Launch the app on a device with a small screen size (e.g., 320x568).
Navigate through all main screens and features.
Check for any overlapping, cut-off, or misaligned UI elements.
Repeat steps 1-3 on devices with medium (e.g., 375x667) and large (e.g., 414x896) screen sizes.
test_cases.expected_result: The app layout renders correctly on all supported device sizes without overlapping or cut-off elements. All UI elements are fully visible and properly aligned.

test_cases.title: Verify all user-facing text is fully translated into English
steps: Launch the app with the device language set to English.
Navigate through all screens, menus, dialogs, and notifications.
Inspect every user-facing text string for untranslated content or placeholders.
test_cases.expected_result: All user-facing text is fully translated into English with no untranslated strings, placeholders, or mixed-language content.

test_cases.title: Verify automated layout tests pass for at least 5 common screen sizes
steps: Run the automated layout test suite.
Confirm that the test suite includes at least 5 common screen sizes (e.g., 320x568, 375x667, 414x896, 768x1024, 1024x1366).
Check the test results for any failures.
test_cases.expected_result: Automated layout tests pass for at least 5 common screen sizes with no failures.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode toggle is available in settings menu
steps: Open the app and navigate to the settings menu.
Look for a dark mode toggle or option.
Toggle the dark mode switch to on.
test_cases.expected_result: A dark mode toggle is present in the settings menu and can be turned on successfully.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode is applied consistently across all screens
steps: Enable dark mode from the settings menu.
Navigate through all main screens of the app (home, list, detail, settings, etc.).
Check that each screen uses the dark color scheme.
test_cases.expected_result: All screens and components display in dark mode with consistent colors and no light-mode elements remain.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode text contrast meets WCAG AA standards
steps: Enable dark mode.
Use a contrast checking tool or manually inspect text elements on various screens.
Measure the contrast ratio between text and background colors.
test_cases.expected_result: All text in dark mode has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text, meeting WCAG AA standards.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode toggle persists after app restart
steps: Enable dark mode in settings.
Close the app completely and reopen it.
Navigate to settings and check the dark mode toggle state.
test_cases.expected_result: Dark mode remains enabled after restarting the app, and the toggle reflects the saved preference.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode toggle is easy to find and use
steps: Open the app and navigate to the settings menu.
Observe the placement and labeling of the dark mode toggle.
Attempt to toggle it on and off.
test_cases.expected_result: The dark mode toggle is clearly labeled and easily accessible within the settings menu, and toggling it is intuitive.

test_cases.title: Verify dark mode does not cause visual glitches or unreadable content
steps: Enable dark mode.
Navigate through all screens and interact with various UI elements (buttons, forms, lists).
Check for any overlapping text, low contrast, or elements that are not visible.
test_cases.expected_result: No visual glitches occur, and all content remains readable and properly displayed in dark mode.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message for card declined
steps: Initiate a payment with a card that will be declined.
Observe the error message displayed after the payment fails.
test_cases.expected_result: The user sees a specific error message stating 'Card declined' and a suggested action such as 'Try a different payment method' or 'Contact your bank'. The message appears within 2 seconds and is dismissible.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message for insufficient funds
steps: Initiate a payment with a card that has insufficient funds.
Observe the error message displayed after the payment fails.
test_cases.expected_result: The user sees a specific error message stating 'Insufficient funds' and a suggested action such as 'Try a different payment method' or 'Contact your bank'. The message appears within 2 seconds and is dismissible.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message for network issues
steps: Initiate a payment while the device has no network connectivity.
Observe the error message displayed after the payment fails.
test_cases.expected_result: The user sees a specific error message explaining a network issue and a suggested action such as 'Check your internet connection and try again'. The message appears within 2 seconds and is dismissible.

test_cases.title: Verify error message includes suggested action
steps: Trigger a payment failure (e.g., card declined).
Check the error message content for a suggested action.
test_cases.expected_result: The error message includes a clear suggested action such as 'Try a different payment method' or 'Contact your bank'.

test_cases.title: Verify error message appears within 2 seconds
steps: Initiate a payment that will fail.
Measure the time from payment failure to error message display.
test_cases.expected_result: The error message is displayed within 2 seconds of the payment failure.

test_cases.title: Verify error message is dismissible
steps: Trigger a payment failure and wait for the error message to appear.
Attempt to dismiss the error message.
test_cases.expected_result: The error message can be dismissed by the user (e.g., via a close button or tapping outside).

test_cases.title: Verify error message is clear and actionable for users
steps: Simulate a payment failure.
Review the error message text for clarity and actionability.
test_cases.expected_result: The error message clearly explains the reason for failure and provides a specific next step, making it easy for the user to understand and act.

test_cases.title: Verify specific error message on card linking failure
steps: Open the app and navigate to the card linking screen.
Enter an invalid card number (e.g., 1234 5678 9012 3456).
Submit the card linking form.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: A specific error message is shown indicating the reason for failure, such as 'Invalid card number' or 'Card not supported'.

test_cases.title: Verify 'Need help?' link opens troubleshooting article
steps: Open the app and navigate to the card linking screen.
Enter an invalid card number to trigger a failure.
Click on the 'Need help?' link displayed in the error message.
Observe the resulting screen.
test_cases.expected_result: A help article with troubleshooting steps for common card linking issues opens.

test_cases.title: Verify retry without re-entering card details on temporary network failure
steps: Open the app and navigate to the card linking screen.
Enter valid card details.
Simulate a temporary network failure during submission (e.g., enable airplane mode).
Submit the card linking form and observe the error.
Disable airplane mode to restore network.
Click the retry button.
test_cases.expected_result: The user can retry linking without re-entering all card details, and the card links successfully after network is restored.

test_cases.title: Verify payment denial notification after multiple successful transactions
steps: Simulate a user account that has completed several successful transactions.
Attempt a new payment transaction that gets denied.
Check the user's notification or error screen for a message explaining the reason and resolution steps.
test_cases.expected_result: The user receives a clear notification explaining the reason for the denial (e.g., 'Verify your identity') and how to resolve it.

test_cases.title: Verify automatic flagging of accounts with repeated payment denials
steps: Simulate a user account that experiences multiple payment denials in a short period.
Check the backend system or admin panel for the account to be flagged for review.
test_cases.expected_result: The system automatically flags the account for review after detecting a pattern of repeated denials.

test_cases.title: Verify support contact option on payment denial error screen
steps: Trigger a payment denial scenario.
On the error screen, look for a way to contact support directly.
test_cases.expected_result: The error screen provides a direct link or button to contact support, allowing the user to resolve the issue.

test_cases.title: Verify notification clarity and actionability for payment denial
steps: Simulate a payment denial after successful transactions.
Read the notification message and check if it includes a clear reason and actionable steps.
test_cases.expected_result: The notification clearly states the reason for denial and provides actionable steps (e.g., 'Verify your identity') to resolve the issue.

test_cases.title: Verify no regression in payment flow for successful transactions
steps: Perform a normal payment transaction that should succeed.
Confirm the transaction completes without any denial or error.
test_cases.expected_result: Successful transactions continue to work without any regression, and no false denial notifications are shown.

test_cases.title: Verify payment success rate meets 99.5% threshold over 30 days
steps: Set up a test environment with a mock payment gateway.
Simulate 10,000 payment transactions over a 30-day period.
Record the number of successful transactions and total attempts.
Calculate the success rate.
test_cases.expected_result: The payment success rate is at least 99.5% (i.e., at least 9,950 successful transactions out of 10,000 attempts).

test_cases.title: Verify unexpected payment error rate is below 0.5%
steps: Set up a test environment with a mock payment gateway.
Simulate 10,000 payment attempts over a 30-day period.
Count the number of attempts that result in an unexpected error (timeout, server error, etc.).
Calculate the error rate.
test_cases.expected_result: The unexpected error rate is no more than 0.5% (i.e., at most 50 errors out of 10,000 attempts).

test_cases.title: Verify automatic retry of failed payment requests up to 3 times
steps: Set up a test environment with a mock payment gateway that fails the first two attempts and succeeds on the third.
Initiate a payment transaction.
Observe the number of retry attempts made by the app.
Verify the transaction completes successfully after the third attempt.
test_cases.expected_result: The app automatically retries failed payment requests up to 3 times before showing an error. In this scenario, the transaction succeeds on the third attempt and no error is shown to the user.

test_cases.title: Verify user sees error after 3 failed payment retries
steps: Set up a test environment with a mock payment gateway that always fails.
Initiate a payment transaction.
Observe the app's behavior after the third failed attempt.
Check the user interface for an error message.
test_cases.expected_result: After 3 automatic retries, the app shows an error message to the user indicating that the payment could not be processed.

test_cases.title: Verify payment processing does not show random failures during normal use
steps: Set up a test environment with a stable payment gateway.
Perform a series of 100 payment transactions under normal conditions.
Record any failures or errors encountered.
Verify that all transactions complete without unexpected errors.
test_cases.expected_result: All 100 payment transactions complete successfully without any random failures or unexpected errors.

test_cases.title: Verify successful payment and top-up without errors
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment or top-up screen.
Select a payment method (e.g., credit card, PayPal).
Enter valid payment details and confirm the transaction.
Verify that the payment or top-up is completed successfully.
test_cases.expected_result: The payment or top-up completes without any error messages or limitations, and the user sees a confirmation of the successful transaction.

test_cases.title: Verify coupon redemption works without failures
steps: Navigate to the payment or top-up screen.
Enter a valid coupon code in the designated field.
Apply the coupon and proceed with the transaction.
Verify that the coupon is accepted and the discount is applied.
test_cases.expected_result: The coupon is redeemed successfully without any error messages, and the discount is applied to the transaction.

test_cases.title: Verify TourPass redemption works without failures
steps: Navigate to the payment or top-up screen.
Select the TourPass option.
Enter valid TourPass details or redeem a TourPass code.
Confirm the transaction and verify the TourPass is applied.
test_cases.expected_result: The TourPass is redeemed successfully without any error messages, and the benefits are applied to the transaction.

test_cases.title: Verify no payment-related error messages appear during transaction flow
steps: Initiate a payment or top-up transaction.
Complete the transaction using a valid payment method.
Monitor the entire flow for any error messages or alerts.
Check that no payment-related errors are displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: No payment-related error messages appear at any point during the transaction flow, and the transaction completes successfully.

test_cases.title: Verify payment failure scenario is handled gracefully
steps: Attempt a payment with insufficient funds or invalid payment details.
Observe the app's response to the failed payment.
Check that an appropriate error message is shown and the user can retry or choose another method.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a clear error message explaining the failure, and the user is able to retry the payment or select an alternative payment method without the app crashing or becoming stuck.

test_cases.title: Verify user can add a credit or debit card without errors
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment methods section.
Select the option to add a new card.
Enter valid credit card details (number, expiry, CVV).
Submit the card information.
test_cases.expected_result: The card is successfully added without any error messages, and a confirmation is shown.

test_cases.title: Verify linked card appears in payment methods
steps: Add a valid credit or debit card as per TC-80.1.
Navigate to the payment methods section.
Check the list of saved payment methods.
test_cases.expected_result: The newly added card is displayed in the list of payment methods with correct details.

test_cases.title: Verify card linking works for supported card types and regions
steps: Attempt to add cards of different supported types (e.g., Visa, Mastercard) and from supported regions.
Enter valid details for each card.
Submit each card and observe the result.
test_cases.expected_result: All supported card types and regions are successfully linked without errors.

test_cases.title: Verify error handling when adding an invalid card
steps: Navigate to the payment methods section.
Select add a new card.
Enter invalid card details (e.g., incorrect number, expired date).
Submit the card information.
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message is displayed, and the card is not added. The user can correct the details and retry.

test_cases.title: Verify card linking process is intuitive and clear
steps: Open the payment methods section.
Attempt to add a new card without prior instructions.
Observe the user interface and flow.
test_cases.expected_result: The process is straightforward with clear labels and guidance, allowing users to complete card linking without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify international card can be added successfully

Submit the card information.
test_cases.expected_result: The international card is added successfully without any error messages. The card appears in the list of saved payment methods.

test_cases.title: Verify payment with international card completes without errors

Select the international card as the payment method.
Confirm the payment.
test_cases.expected_result: The payment is processed successfully. No 'transaction error' or 'system error' messages are displayed. The transaction is completed and a confirmation is shown.

test_cases.title: Verify US user can complete transaction with international card
steps: Set the app region to United States.
Add an international card (e.g., a card issued in another country).

test_cases.expected_result: The transaction is completed successfully without any errors. The US user is able to use their international card for payment.

test_cases.title: Verify no system error messages appear for international card payments
steps: Add an international card.
Attempt to make a payment.
Observe any error messages displayed during the process.
test_cases.expected_result: No 'transaction error' or 'system error' messages appear. The payment proceeds smoothly or fails with a clear, user-friendly message if the card is declined.

test_cases.title: Verify international card addition and payment are user-friendly
steps: Navigate to the payment method section.
Attempt to add an international card.
Observe the clarity of instructions and error messages.
Complete a payment with the international card.
test_cases.expected_result: The process is intuitive and clear. Any error messages are helpful and guide the user to resolve issues. The user can complete the task without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify international credit card payment completes without transaction or system error
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment screen.
Enter a valid international credit card number, expiration date, and CVV.
Enter the payment amount and confirm the payment.
Observe the payment processing and completion.
test_cases.expected_result: The payment is processed successfully without any 'transaction error' or 'system error' messages. The user receives a confirmation of the successful payment.

test_cases.title: Verify clear error message is shown when payment fails due to invalid card details
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment screen.

Attempt to confirm the payment.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: A clear and helpful error message is displayed indicating the issue with the card details, without showing a generic 'transaction error' or 'system error'. The user can understand what went wrong and how to correct it.

test_cases.title: Verify payment with international card does not show system error during processing
steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment screen.
Enter a valid international credit card.
Initiate the payment and wait for the processing to complete.
Monitor the app for any system error messages during the processing.

steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment screen.

Observe the error message and any guidance provided.

steps: Open the app and navigate to the payment screen.
Select a supported international card type (e.g., Visa, Mastercard).
Enter valid card details.
Complete the payment.
Observe the payment outcome.
test_cases.expected_result: The payment is processed successfully without any 'transaction error' message. The user receives a confirmation of the successful payment.

steps: Open the app and navigate to a mini-program that requests location.
Grant location permission when prompted.
Move to a known rural location with clear GPS signal.
