Attempt to change privacy-related settings, such as opting out of data collection.
Evaluate the ease of finding and changing these settings.
test_cases.expected_result: Privacy settings are clearly labeled and easy to locate within the settings menu, and changing them requires minimal steps and is intuitive for the user.

test_cases.title: Verify feedback/survey interface loads without errors
steps: Open the app and navigate to the feedback/survey section.
Wait for the interface to load.
Observe if any error messages such as 'questionnaire does not exist' or server busy appear.
test_cases.expected_result: The feedback/survey interface loads successfully without any error messages in all supported environments.

test_cases.title: Verify user can submit feedback successfully
steps: Open the feedback/survey interface.
Fill in the required fields with valid input.
Submit the feedback.
Confirm that the submission is successful without any error messages.
test_cases.expected_result: The feedback is submitted successfully without encountering 'questionnaire does not exist' or server busy messages.

test_cases.title: Verify clear error handling when service is temporarily unavailable
steps: Simulate a scenario where the feedback service is temporarily unavailable (e.g., by disconnecting the network or using a mock server).
Open the feedback/survey interface.
Attempt to submit feedback.
Observe the error message displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: A clear and helpful error message is displayed, informing the user that the service is temporarily unavailable, without crashing or showing ambiguous errors.

test_cases.title: Verify hide option is available on persistent homepage banner
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Wait for the persistent banner (e.g., '五福') to appear.
Look for a 'Hide' or 'Dismiss' option on the banner.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Hide' or 'Dismiss' option is visible on the persistent banner when it appears.

test_cases.title: Verify hidden banner does not reappear during current session
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Wait for the persistent banner to appear.
Tap the 'Hide' or 'Dismiss' option on the banner.
Navigate to another mode or screen and return to the homepage within the same session.
test_cases.expected_result: The banner does not reappear during the current session after being hidden.

test_cases.title: Verify user preference to hide banner is saved across sessions
steps: Launch the app and navigate to the homepage.
Wait for the persistent banner to appear.
Tap the 'Hide' or 'Dismiss' option on the banner.
Close the app completely and relaunch it.
Navigate to the homepage.
test_cases.expected_result: The banner does not reappear after relaunching the app, confirming the user's preference is saved across sessions.

test_cases.title: Verify user can dismiss forced update prompt and continue using basic features
steps: Launch the app with an outdated version that triggers a forced update prompt.
Attempt to dismiss or skip the update prompt.
Try to use a basic feature such as scanning.
test_cases.expected_result: The update prompt can be dismissed, and the user can continue using basic features like scanning without updating the app.

test_cases.title: Verify rollback to previous version option is available in settings
steps: Open the app settings.
Navigate to the version or update section.
Look for a 'Rollback to previous version' option.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Rollback to previous version' option is present in the settings and is accessible.

test_cases.title: Verify rollback functionality restores previous version
steps: Ensure the app is on a version that supports rollback.
Go to settings and select 'Rollback to previous version'.
Confirm the rollback action.
Check the app version after rollback.
test_cases.expected_result: The app successfully rolls back to the previous version, and the version number reflects the change.

test_cases.title: Verify update prompt does not block basic features when dismissed
steps: Launch the app with an update prompt.
Dismiss the prompt.
Attempt to use scanning and other basic features.
test_cases.expected_result: After dismissing the update prompt, all basic features remain fully functional without any interruption.

test_cases.title: Verify update prompt can be dismissed on all supported screens
steps: Navigate to different screens in the app where the update prompt may appear.
Attempt to dismiss the prompt on each screen.
Confirm that dismissal works consistently.
test_cases.expected_result: The update prompt can be dismissed on all screens where it appears, and the app remains usable.

test_cases.title: Verify rollback option is clearly visible and understandable in settings
steps: Open the settings screen.
Look for the rollback option.
Read the label and any accompanying description.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Rollback to previous version' option is clearly visible and its purpose is understandable to the user.

test_cases.title: Verify update prompt dismissal is intuitive for users
steps: Present the update prompt to a user.
Observe if the user can easily find and use the dismiss option.
Ask the user to rate the ease of dismissing the prompt.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can intuitively dismiss the update prompt without confusion or difficulty.

test_cases.title: Verify basic features remain responsive after dismissing update prompt
steps: Dismiss the update prompt.
Perform a series of basic operations such as scanning multiple items.
Measure response times and ensure no lag.
test_cases.expected_result: Basic features remain responsive and perform within acceptable time limits after dismissing the update prompt.

test_cases.title: Verify lock screen widgets are available for scanning and status
steps: Open the widget gallery on a supported iOS device.
Search for the app's lock screen widgets.
Add the scanning widget to the lock screen.
Add the status widget to the lock screen.
Check that both widgets appear on the lock screen.
test_cases.expected_result: The widget gallery includes lock screen widgets for scanning and status, and both can be added and displayed on the lock screen.

test_cases.title: Verify lock screen widgets can be customized from the widget gallery
steps: Open the widget gallery on a supported iOS device.
Select the app's lock screen widget.
Customize the widget settings (e.g., size, displayed data).
Add the customized widget to the lock screen.
Verify the widget reflects the customizations.
test_cases.expected_result: The widget can be customized from the widget gallery, and the lock screen widget displays the customized settings.

test_cases.title: Verify lock screen widgets function correctly on supported iOS versions
steps: Identify the supported iOS versions for the app.
On each supported iOS version, add the scanning and status widgets to the lock screen.
Interact with the widgets (e.g., tap to open the app).
Verify the widgets update with current data and respond to interactions.
test_cases.expected_result: The lock screen widgets function correctly on all supported iOS versions, displaying current data and responding to user interactions.

test_cases.title: Verify lock screen widgets are discoverable and easy to add
steps: Navigate to the lock screen edit mode.
Tap the add widget button.
Search for the app in the widget gallery.
Add the scanning widget to the lock screen.
Observe the ease of finding and adding the widget.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can easily find and add the lock screen widgets from the widget gallery without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify lock screen widgets do not cause performance issues
steps: Add the scanning and status widgets to the lock screen.
Lock the device and observe the lock screen rendering.
Unlock and lock the device multiple times.
Monitor device performance (e.g., battery, responsiveness) while widgets are active.
test_cases.expected_result: The lock screen widgets do not cause noticeable performance degradation, such as lag or excessive battery drain.

test_cases.title: Verify app crash rate is reduced by at least 20% compared to previous version
steps: Launch the app on a supported device and OS version.
Perform a series of common user actions such as browsing, searching, and making purchases.
Repeat the actions multiple times to simulate typical usage.
Monitor the app for any crashes or unexpected terminations.
Compare the crash rate with the previous version's crash rate.
test_cases.expected_result: The app does not crash during the test, and the crash rate is reduced by at least 20% compared to the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify average app launch time is reduced by at least 15%
steps: Clear the app cache and close all background processes.
Launch the app and measure the time from tapping the app icon to the home screen being fully displayed.
Repeat the launch process at least 10 times.
Calculate the average launch time.
Compare the average launch time with the previous version's average launch time.
test_cases.expected_result: The average app launch time is reduced by at least 15% compared to the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify user satisfaction rating improves by at least 0.5 stars
steps: Deploy the new version to a test group of users.
Collect user ratings and feedback after a defined period.
Calculate the average star rating from the collected data.
Compare the average rating with the previous version's average rating.
test_cases.expected_result: The average user satisfaction rating improves by at least 0.5 stars compared to the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify user can proceed without precise location access
steps: Launch the app for the first time.
When the location permission prompt appears, choose to not grant precise location access.
Select the option to use approximate location or skip location permission entirely.
Continue using the app and verify core functionality.
test_cases.expected_result: The app allows the user to proceed without precise location access, and core features work with approximate location or no location permission.

test_cases.title: Verify prompt explains benefits and alternatives for precise location
steps: Launch the app and trigger the location permission flow.
Observe the prompt that appears when precise location is not granted.
Check that the prompt explains the benefits of precise location and offers alternatives such as approximate location or skipping.
test_cases.expected_result: A clear prompt is displayed explaining why precise location is beneficial and provides options to use approximate location or skip location permission entirely.

test_cases.title: Verify app functions correctly with approximate location only
steps: Grant approximate location permission when prompted.
Use the app's main features that rely on location.
Verify that location-based features work with reduced accuracy.
test_cases.expected_result: The app functions correctly with approximate location, and all core features operate without errors or crashes.

test_cases.title: Verify app does not crash during top 10 user flows
steps: Launch the app and navigate through the top 10 user flows (e.g., login, browse, search, view item, add to cart, checkout, etc.).
Perform each flow multiple times, including edge cases like rapid tapping, poor network, and backgrounding the app.
Monitor for any crashes or unexpected terminations.
test_cases.expected_result: The app completes all top 10 user flows without crashing or terminating unexpectedly. No critical bugs are encountered.

test_cases.title: Verify app performance is responsive during typical usage
steps: Launch the app and perform common actions such as opening screens, scrolling lists, and loading images.
Measure response times for each action using performance monitoring tools.
Repeat actions under normal network conditions and with a slow network simulation.
test_cases.expected_result: All user interactions respond within acceptable time limits (e.g., under 2 seconds for screen transitions, under 1 second for UI updates). No noticeable lag or jankiness.

test_cases.title: Verify usability of core features is intuitive and clear
steps: Ask a new user to perform key tasks without guidance, such as creating an account, finding a product, and completing a purchase.
Observe where users hesitate, make errors, or express confusion.
Collect feedback on clarity of labels, icons, and navigation.
test_cases.expected_result: Users can complete core tasks without assistance, with minimal errors and confusion. Feedback indicates that the interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.

test_cases.title: Verify that previously fixed issues remain resolved
steps: Identify a list of previously reported critical bugs and issues from user reviews.
Reproduce the scenarios that triggered those bugs.
Check that the bugs do not reappear and that the app behaves correctly.
test_cases.expected_result: All previously fixed critical bugs remain resolved. No regression is observed in the affected areas.

test_cases.title: Verify no false network error appears with stable internet
steps: Connect the device to a stable internet connection.
Open the app and navigate to a screen that performs network requests.
Perform actions that trigger network calls (e.g., refresh data, load content).
Observe whether any network error message appears.
test_cases.expected_result: No network error message is displayed when the device has a working internet connection. All network requests succeed without error prompts.

test_cases.title: Verify network error message includes Retry and Check Connection buttons
steps: Simulate a genuine network failure (e.g., enable airplane mode or disconnect Wi-Fi).
Trigger a network request in the app.
Observe the network error message that appears.
Check the message for a 'Retry' button and a 'Check Connection' diagnostic option.
test_cases.expected_result: The network error message includes both a 'Retry' button and a 'Check Connection' diagnostic option.

test_cases.title: Verify app automatically retries failed network requests
steps: Simulate a temporary network failure (e.g., enable airplane mode).
Trigger a network request in the app.
Wait for the request to fail.
Restore the network connection (e.g., disable airplane mode) without user intervention.
Observe whether the app automatically retries the failed request and completes it successfully.
test_cases.expected_result: The app automatically retries the failed network request once the connection is restored, and the request completes successfully without requiring user action.

test_cases.title: Verify update pop-up appears at most once per session
steps: Launch the app and trigger an update check.
Dismiss the update pop-up if it appears.
Navigate within the app and trigger another update check.
Observe whether the update pop-up appears again.
test_cases.expected_result: The update pop-up appears at most once per app session, even if multiple update checks are triggered.

test_cases.title: Verify 'Remind Me Later' delays update prompt for at least 24 hours
steps: Launch the app and wait for the update pop-up to appear.
Tap 'Remind Me Later'.
Close the app completely.
Reopen the app after 24 hours and trigger an update check.
Observe whether the update pop-up appears.
test_cases.expected_result: The update pop-up does not appear within 24 hours after selecting 'Remind Me Later'. After 24 hours, the prompt may appear again.

test_cases.title: Verify update prompt can be permanently dismissed from settings
steps: Open the app settings.
Locate the option to disable update notifications.
Enable the option to permanently dismiss update prompts.
Close and reopen the app.
Trigger an update check and observe whether the update pop-up appears.
test_cases.expected_result: After enabling the permanent dismissal option in settings, the update pop-up does not appear in any future sessions.

test_cases.title: Verify update pop-up does not interrupt critical user tasks
steps: Start a critical user task, such as making a purchase or completing a form.
Trigger an update check while the task is in progress.
Observe whether the update pop-up interrupts the task.
test_cases.expected_result: The update pop-up does not interrupt critical user tasks; it appears only at appropriate times, such as app launch or when the user is idle.

test_cases.title: Verify update pop-up frequency is reduced in regression testing
steps: Perform a regression test suite that includes multiple app launches and update checks.
Count the number of times the update pop-up appears across all sessions.
Verify that the pop-up appears at most once per session.
test_cases.expected_result: The update pop-up appears at most once per session across all regression test scenarios, confirming the frequency reduction.

test_cases.title: Verify public statement addressing ethical concerns is published
steps: Open the app and navigate to the news section.
Check for a public statement addressing ethical concerns.
Visit the company website and verify the same statement is present.
test_cases.expected_result: A public statement addressing the ethical concerns is published in the app's news section and on the company website.

test_cases.title: Verify internal policy updates are summarized for users
steps: Open the app and navigate to the news section or a dedicated policy update area.
Look for a summary of internal policy updates addressing ethical concerns.
Confirm the summary is accessible to all users.
test_cases.expected_result: A summary of internal policy updates is available to users, clearly addressing the ethical concerns raised.

test_cases.title: Verify user sentiment improves after update
steps: Monitor user reviews and ratings for 3 months after the update.
Collect sentiment data from app store reviews and in-app feedback.
Compare sentiment scores before and after the update.
test_cases.expected_result: User sentiment in reviews improves by at least 10% within 3 months of the update.

test_cases.title: Verify foreign credit cards are accepted for in-app purchases
steps: Set the device region to a foreign country (e.g., Japan).
Add a foreign credit card (e.g., a Japanese credit card) to the App Store account.
Attempt to make an in-app purchase within the app.
Complete the purchase flow.
test_cases.expected_result: The in-app purchase is successfully completed using the foreign credit card without any payment errors or restrictions.

test_cases.title: Verify app content is localized for at least 5 additional languages
steps: Change the device language to one of the newly supported languages (e.g., Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Chinese).
Launch the app.
Navigate through the main screens and settings.
Check that all user-facing text, labels, and messages are displayed in the selected language.
test_cases.expected_result: All user-facing content is displayed in the selected language, with no untranslated strings or English fallback. At least 5 additional languages are supported.

test_cases.title: Verify foreign users can access all features without service restrictions
steps: Set the device region to a foreign country (e.g., Brazil).
Create a new account or log in with an existing account.
Attempt to access all major features of the app, including content browsing, search, and any premium features.
Verify that no region-based restrictions or error messages appear.
test_cases.expected_result: Foreign users can access all features without encountering any service restrictions, error messages, or blocked content.

test_cases.title: Verify localized content is accurate and culturally appropriate
steps: Change the device language to a newly supported language (e.g., Japanese).
Launch the app and navigate through various screens.
Review translated text for accuracy, grammar, and cultural appropriateness.
Check that date formats, currency, and other locale-specific elements are correctly adapted.
test_cases.expected_result: All localized content is accurate, grammatically correct, and culturally appropriate. Locale-specific elements such as dates and currency are correctly formatted.

test_cases.title: Verify foreign credit card payment failure handling
steps: Set the device region to a foreign country (e.g., Germany).
Add a foreign credit card that is declined or has insufficient funds.
Attempt to make an in-app purchase.
Observe the error message and recovery options.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a clear and helpful error message explaining the payment failure and provides options to retry or use a different payment method. No crash or unhandled error occurs.

test_cases.title: Verify app performance remains stable with localized content
steps: Change the device language to a newly supported language (e.g., Chinese).
Launch the app and navigate through multiple screens quickly.
Monitor app responsiveness and loading times.
Repeat the process for all supported languages.
test_cases.expected_result: The app remains responsive and performs without significant delays or crashes when using localized content. Loading times are within acceptable limits.

test_cases.title: Verify app supports screen rotation in both orientations
steps: Launch the app on a supported device.
Rotate the device to landscape orientation.
Verify the app layout adjusts correctly.
Rotate the device to portrait orientation.
Verify the app layout returns to the correct portrait view.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays correctly in both portrait and landscape orientations without any layout issues, overlapping elements, or loss of functionality.

test_cases.title: Verify usability improvements with larger touch targets
steps: Open the app and navigate to the main screen.
Identify interactive elements such as buttons, links, and menu items.
Measure the touch target size of each interactive element.
Attempt to tap each element accurately.
test_cases.expected_result: All interactive elements have a touch target size of at least 44x44 pixels (or the platform recommended minimum) and can be tapped accurately without accidental taps on adjacent elements.

test_cases.title: Verify clear navigation after usability improvements
steps: Launch the app and navigate through all main sections.
Check that the navigation menu is clearly visible and labeled.
Verify that the user can easily return to the home screen from any section.
Test the back button and any breadcrumb navigation if present.
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation is intuitive and clear, with visible labels and a straightforward path to return to the home screen. Users can navigate without confusion.

test_cases.title: Verify no regression in app performance after update
steps: Install the updated version of the app.
Launch the app and measure the startup time.
Perform common tasks such as browsing, searching, and data entry.
Monitor for any crashes, freezes, or significant slowdowns.
Compare performance metrics with the previous version if available.
test_cases.expected_result: The app starts within the expected time, performs common tasks smoothly, and shows no crashes, freezes, or significant performance degradation compared to the previous version.

test_cases.title: Verify app stability during rotation on various devices
steps: Launch the app on a device with a small screen.
Rotate the device multiple times quickly between portrait and landscape.
Repeat the same on a device with a large screen.
Check for any crashes, freezes, or UI glitches during rotation.
test_cases.expected_result: The app remains stable during rapid rotation on all supported devices, with no crashes, freezes, or UI glitches.

test_cases.title: Verify reported error codes no longer appear
steps: Reproduce the scenario that triggered the reported error codes (e.g., specific user actions or conditions).
Perform the actions that previously caused the error codes.
Observe the app behavior and any error messages displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The reported error codes do not appear during the user session; the app functions normally without displaying those specific errors.

test_cases.title: Verify specific bugs are fixed through regression testing
steps: Identify the specific bugs reported by users (from source reviews).
Execute regression test cases covering the affected functionality.
Verify that the bugs no longer reproduce and that related features work as expected.
test_cases.expected_result: All identified bugs are fixed; regression tests pass without any recurrence of the reported issues.

test_cases.title: Verify user reports of errors decrease after update
steps: Deploy the update that includes the bug fixes.
Monitor user feedback and error reports for a period of one month.
Compare the number of error reports before and after the update.
test_cases.expected_result: User reports of the specific errors decrease by at least 50% within one month of the update.

test_cases.title: Verify push notification is delivered within 5 minutes of a relevant event
steps: Enable reminders for a feature such as 'Ant Forest' in the app settings.
Trigger a relevant event that should generate a push notification.
Wait up to 5 minutes and check if the push notification is received on the device.
test_cases.expected_result: The user receives a push notification within 5 minutes of the relevant event occurring.

test_cases.title: Verify push notification settings are saved and reflected correctly
steps: Navigate to the app settings and enable push notifications for a specific feature.
Close the settings screen and reopen it to confirm the setting is still enabled.
Disable the push notification setting and confirm it is saved.
Trigger a relevant event and verify no notification is received.
test_cases.expected_result: Push notification settings are correctly saved and reflected in the app; enabling results in notifications, disabling results in no notifications.

test_cases.title: Verify no more than 1% of users report missing notifications in a 30-day period
steps: Monitor user feedback and support tickets related to missing push notifications over a 30-day period.
Calculate the percentage of users reporting missing notifications out of the total active user base.
Compare the percentage to the 1% threshold.
test_cases.expected_result: The percentage of users reporting missing notifications is less than or equal to 1% over the 30-day period.

test_cases.title: Verify prompt for more details on short reviews
steps: Open the app and navigate to the review submission screen.
Enter a review with fewer than 20 characters.
Attempt to submit the review.
test_cases.expected_result: The app displays a prompt asking the user to provide more details before allowing submission.

test_cases.title: Verify no prompt for reviews with 20 or more characters
steps: Open the app and navigate to the review submission screen.
Enter a review with 20 or more characters.
Attempt to submit the review.
test_cases.expected_result: The review is submitted without any additional prompt.

test_cases.title: Verify vague complaints are categorized into predefined categories
steps: Submit a vague complaint (e.g., 'bad app') through the review submission screen.
Navigate to the admin or analytics dashboard.
Check the categorization of the complaint.
test_cases.expected_result: The complaint is categorized into one of at least 5 predefined categories (e.g., performance, usability, bugs, content, other).

test_cases.title: Verify prompt appears only once per review submission
steps: Open the app and navigate to the review submission screen.
Enter a review with fewer than 20 characters.
Submit the review and receive the prompt.
Dismiss the prompt and attempt to submit the same review again.
test_cases.expected_result: The prompt appears only once per review submission; after dismissing, the user can submit without being prompted again.

test_cases.title: Verify prompt is user-friendly and clear
steps: Open the app and navigate to the review submission screen.
Enter a review with fewer than 20 characters.
Observe the prompt message and its presentation.
test_cases.expected_result: The prompt is clear, concise, and provides guidance on how to add more details, without being intrusive.

test_cases.title: Verify categorization works for various vague complaints
steps: Submit multiple vague complaints with different wording (e.g., 'terrible', 'waste of time', 'doesn't work').
Navigate to the admin dashboard.
Check that each complaint is assigned to a predefined category.
test_cases.expected_result: Each vague complaint is correctly categorized into one of the predefined categories, with no uncategorized complaints.

test_cases.title: Verify percentage of vague reviews decreases over time
steps: Record the current percentage of vague reviews (reviews with less than 20 characters) in the analytics dashboard.
Implement the feature and wait for 3 months.
Check the percentage of vague reviews in the analytics dashboard.
test_cases.expected_result: The percentage of vague reviews decreases by at least 20% compared to the baseline.

test_cases.title: Verify Credit Services section is accessible from main menu
steps: Open the app and navigate to the main menu.
Look for a 'Credit Services' section.
Tap on the 'Credit Services' section.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Credit Services' section is accessible from the main menu and opens a page explaining credit and loan terms in plain language.

test_cases.title: Verify users must acknowledge terms before using credit or loan feature
steps: Navigate to the 'Credit Services' section.
Attempt to use any credit or loan feature without acknowledging the terms.
Observe if a prompt appears requiring acknowledgment.
Acknowledge the terms and proceed.
test_cases.expected_result: Users cannot use any credit or loan feature until they acknowledge the terms. An acknowledgment prompt appears and blocks usage until accepted.

test_cases.title: Verify financial risk warning is displayed on first access to credit services
steps: Open the app and navigate to the 'Credit Services' section for the first time.
Observe the screen for a warning about financial risks.
test_cases.expected_result: A warning about financial risks is displayed when users first access credit services.

test_cases.title: Verify credit service terms are clear and transparent
steps: Navigate to the 'Credit Services' section.
Review the displayed information about interest rates, repayment terms, and risks.
Assess if the language is plain and easy to understand.
test_cases.expected_result: The credit services section explains interest rates, repayment terms, and risks in plain language that is easy for users to understand.

test_cases.title: Verify user can add a foreign credit card in payment settings
steps: Open the app and navigate to payment settings.
Select 'Add Payment Method'.
Choose 'Credit Card' and enter a foreign credit card number (e.g., Visa or Mastercard).
Enter the card details and save.
test_cases.expected_result: The foreign credit card is successfully added and appears in the list of payment methods.

test_cases.title: Verify user can add a PayPal account in payment settings
steps: Open the app and navigate to payment settings.
Select 'Add Payment Method'.
Choose 'PayPal' and enter the PayPal account email.
Confirm the addition.
test_cases.expected_result: The PayPal account is successfully added and appears in the list of payment methods.

test_cases.title: Verify a test transaction with a foreign payment method completes successfully
steps: Add a foreign credit card or PayPal account as described in TC-157.1 or TC-157.2.
Initiate a purchase or payment.
Select the foreign payment method.
Complete the transaction.
test_cases.expected_result: The transaction is processed successfully without errors, and a confirmation is shown.

test_cases.title: Verify payment method selection screen shows all supported international options
steps: Open the app and navigate to payment settings.
Select 'Add Payment Method' or view the payment method selection screen.
test_cases.expected_result: The screen displays all supported international payment options including Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal.

test_cases.title: Verify usability of adding a foreign payment method for non-Chinese users
steps: Simulate a non-Chinese user environment (e.g., language set to English, region outside China).
Open the app and navigate to payment settings.
Attempt to add a foreign payment method.
test_cases.expected_result: The process is intuitive and all labels and instructions are clear for non-Chinese users.
